# Load data
```{r}
modify_classes <- function(vector) {
    # Convert factor to character to avoid invalid factor level warnings
    was_factor <- is.factor(vector)
    vector <- as.character(vector)
    
    vector[grepl("MDS|TP53", vector)] <- "MDS.r"
    vector[!grepl("MLLT3", vector) & grepl("KMT2A", vector)] <- "other.KMT2A"
    vector[grepl("MECOM", vector)] <- "MECOM"

    
    # Optionally convert back to factor if input was factor
    if (was_factor) {
      vector <- factor(vector)
    }
    vector
  }

# Filters
DATA_FILTERS <- list(
  min_samples_per_subtype = 10,
  excluded_subtypes = c("AML NOS", "Missing data", "Multi"),
  selected_studies = c(
    "TCGA-LAML",
    "LEUCEGENE",
    "BEATAML1.0-COHORT",
    "AAML0531",
    "AAML1031",
    "AAML03P1",
    "100LUMC"
  )
)

# Load mapping of class labels to numeric labels
label_mapping <- read.csv("../data/label_mapping_all.csv")

# Load leukemia subtype data
leukemia_subtypes <- read.csv("../data/rgas_10feb26.csv")$ICC_Subtype

# Load study metadata
meta <- read.csv("../data/meta_20aug25.csv")
study_names <- meta$Studies

# Filter data based on criteria
subtypes_with_sufficient_samples <- names(which(table(leukemia_subtypes) >= DATA_FILTERS$min_samples_per_subtype))
filter <- which(
  leukemia_subtypes %in% subtypes_with_sufficient_samples &
    !leukemia_subtypes %in% DATA_FILTERS$excluded_subtypes &
    study_names %in% DATA_FILTERS$selected_studies
)

leukemia_subtypes_mod <- modify_classes(leukemia_subtypes)

filtered_leukemia_subtypes <- leukemia_subtypes[filter]
filtered_leukemia_subtypes[filtered_leukemia_subtypes == "MECOM fusion"] <- "MECOM rearrangement"
# Load study metadata
filtered_study_names <- study_names[filter]

meta <- meta[filter, ]
meta$classes <- filtered_leukemia_subtypes
```

## -- Supplementary Table 1: All Subtypes (Included and Excluded)

```{r results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Create data frame for included classes
included_df <- data.frame(
  Subtype = filtered_leukemia_subtypes,
  Cohort = filtered_study_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Create data frame for excluded classes
excluded_df <- data.frame(
  Subtype = leukemia_subtypes[-filter],
  Cohort = study_names[-filter],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Define cohort order (adults first, then pediatric)
cohort_order <- c(
  # Adult cohorts
  "TCGA-LAML",
  "LEUCEGENE",
  "BEATAML1.0-COHORT",
  "100LUMC",
  # Pediatric cohorts
  "AAML0531",
  "AAML1031",
  "AAML03P1"
)

# Function to create cross-tabulation table
create_subtype_table <- function(df, cohort_order) {
  # Create cross-tabulation
  ct <- table(df$Subtype, df$Cohort)
  ct_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct)
  
  # Ensure all cohorts are present (even if 0 counts)
  for (cohort in cohort_order) {
    if (!cohort %in% colnames(ct_df)) {
      ct_df[[cohort]] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  # Reorder columns according to cohort_order
  ct_df <- ct_df[, cohort_order, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Add Total column
  ct_df$Total <- rowSums(ct_df)
  
  # Sort rows by Total (high to low)
  ct_df <- ct_df[order(-ct_df$Total), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Move rownames to a column
  ct_df <- cbind(Subtype = rownames(ct_df), ct_df)
  rownames(ct_df) <- NULL
  
  return(ct_df)
}

# Create tables for included and excluded classes

# For included, we need to show merged classes with breakdowns and
# also group rare recurrent translocations into a single AML subgroup.
included_df_modified <- included_df
included_df_modified$Subtype_Original <- included_df$Subtype

# Start from the standard merged labels (MDS-related, other KMT2A, MECOM)
included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged <- modify_classes(included_df$Subtype)

# Define rare recurrent translocation subtypes to be grouped.
# Allow for both "::" and ".." / comma variants so this works with
# whichever naming is present in filtered_leukemia_subtypes.
rare_tx_subtypes <- c(
  "CBFA2T3::GLIS2",        "CBFA2T3..GLIS2",
  "NUP98::KDM5A",          "NUP98..KDM5A",
  "KAT6A::CREBBP",         "KAT6A..CREBBP",
  "ETV6::MNX1",            "ETV6..MNX1",
  "FUS::ERG", "RBM15::MRTF1", "NUP98::NSD1",
  "NUP98, other partners", "NUP98..other.partners", "PICALM::MLLT10", "PICALM..MLLT10"
)

# Map these to a single merged group
included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged[
  included_df_modified$Subtype_Original %in% rare_tx_subtypes
] <- "other.rare.tx"

# Create table with merged classes
included_table_merged <- create_subtype_table(
  data.frame(Subtype = included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged, 
             Cohort = included_df_modified$Cohort), 
  cohort_order
)

# Rename merged subtypes for display
included_table_merged$Subtype <- gsub("MDS\\.r", "MDS-related", included_table_merged$Subtype)
included_table_merged$Subtype <- gsub("other\\.KMT2A", "Other KMT2A rearrangements", included_table_merged$Subtype)
included_table_merged$Subtype[included_table_merged$Subtype == "MECOM"] <- "MECOM rearrangement"
included_table_merged$Subtype <- gsub(
  "other\\.rare\\.tx",
  "AML with other rare recurring translocations",
  included_table_merged$Subtype
)

# Custom display order for included AML subtypes
# (controls order in both Supplementary Table 1 and Table 1)
# Use the actual row labels from the table.
desired_included_order <- c(
  "APL, t(15;17)/PML::RARA",                 # Acute promyelocytic leukemia
  "AML with t(8;21)/RUNX1::RUNX1T1",
  "AML with inv(16)/t(16;16)/CBFB::MYH11",
  "AML with t(9;11)/MLLT3::KMT2A",
  "Other KMT2A rearrangements",
  "AML with t(6;9)/DEK::NUP214",
  # MECOM rearrangements grouped at merged level
  "MECOM rearrangement",
  "GATA2;MECOM",
  "MECOM, other",
  "AML with other rare recurring translocations",
  "AML with t(9;22)/BCR::ABL1",             # May be absent; ordering still safe
  "NUP98::NSD1",
  "AML with mutated NPM1",
  "AML with in-frame bZIP CEBPA",
  "MDS-related"                             # MDS/AML-related entities at the end
)

included_table_merged$Subtype <- factor(
  included_table_merged$Subtype,
  levels = c(
    desired_included_order,
    setdiff(included_table_merged$Subtype, desired_included_order)
  )
)
included_table_merged <- included_table_merged[order(included_table_merged$Subtype), ]
included_table_merged$Subtype <- as.character(included_table_merged$Subtype)

# Create breakdown tables for merged classes
# MDS.r/MECOM breakdown
mds_subtypes <- included_df_modified$Subtype_Original[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "MDS.r"]
if (length(mds_subtypes) > 0) {
  mds_breakdown <- create_subtype_table(
    data.frame(Subtype = mds_subtypes, 
               Cohort = included_df_modified$Cohort[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "MDS.r"]),
    cohort_order
  )
  mds_breakdown$Subtype <- paste0("<span style='padding-left:20px;'>└─ ", mds_breakdown$Subtype, "</span>")
}

# other.KMT2A breakdown
other_kmt2a_subtypes <- included_df_modified$Subtype_Original[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "other.KMT2A"]
if (length(other_kmt2a_subtypes) > 0) {
  other_kmt2a_breakdown <- create_subtype_table(
    data.frame(Subtype = other_kmt2a_subtypes, 
               Cohort = included_df_modified$Cohort[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "other.KMT2A"]),
    cohort_order
  )
  other_kmt2a_breakdown$Subtype <- paste0("<span style='padding-left:20px;'>└─ ", other_kmt2a_breakdown$Subtype, "</span>")
}

# MECOM breakdown (GATA2;MECOM, MECOM other -> merged as MECOM rearrangement)
mecom_subtypes <- included_df_modified$Subtype_Original[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "MECOM"]
if (length(mecom_subtypes) > 0) {
  mecom_breakdown <- create_subtype_table(
    data.frame(Subtype = mecom_subtypes,
               Cohort = included_df_modified$Cohort[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "MECOM"]),
    cohort_order
  )
  mecom_breakdown$Subtype <- paste0("<span style='padding-left:20px;'>└─ ", mecom_breakdown$Subtype, "</span>")
}

# other.rare.tx breakdown (rare recurring translocations)
rare_tx_subtypes_included <- included_df_modified$Subtype_Original[
  included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "other.rare.tx"
]
if (length(rare_tx_subtypes_included) > 0) {
  other_rare_tx_breakdown <- create_subtype_table(
    data.frame(
      Subtype = rare_tx_subtypes_included,
      Cohort  = included_df_modified$Cohort[included_df_modified$Subtype_Merged == "other.rare.tx"]
    ),
    cohort_order
  )
  # Reorder rare translocations to follow the desired clinical order.
  # Only levels present in the data will appear.
  desired_rare_order <- c(
    "PRDM16::RPN1",
    "NPM1::MLF1",
    "KAT6A::CREBBP",
    "RBM15::MRTF1",
    "NUP98::NSD1",
    "NUP98::KDM5A",
    "NUP98, other partners",
    "ETV6::MNX1",
    "PICALM::MLLT10",
    "FUS::ERG",
    "RUNX1::CBFA2T3",
    "CBFA2T3::GLIS2"
  )
  other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype <- factor(
    other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype,
    levels = c(
      desired_rare_order,
      setdiff(other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype, desired_rare_order)
    )
  )
  other_rare_tx_breakdown <- other_rare_tx_breakdown[
    order(other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype),
  ]
  other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype <- as.character(other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype)

  other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype <- paste0(
    "<span style='padding-left:20px;'>└─ ",
    other_rare_tx_breakdown$Subtype,
    "</span>"
  )
}

# Build the included table with hierarchical structure
included_table_final <- data.frame()
stripe_groups <- c()  # Track which stripe group each row belongs to
current_stripe <- 1

for (i in 1:nrow(included_table_merged)) {
  subtype <- included_table_merged$Subtype[i]
  # Add the merged class row
  included_table_final <- rbind(included_table_final, included_table_merged[i, ])
  stripe_groups <- c(stripe_groups, current_stripe)
  
  # Add breakdown rows if this is a merged class
  if (subtype == "MDS-related" && exists("mds_breakdown")) {
    included_table_final <- rbind(included_table_final, mds_breakdown)
    # Add same stripe group for all breakdown rows
    stripe_groups <- c(stripe_groups, rep(current_stripe, nrow(mds_breakdown)))
  } else if (subtype == "Other KMT2A rearrangements" && exists("other_kmt2a_breakdown")) {
    included_table_final <- rbind(included_table_final, other_kmt2a_breakdown)
    # Add same stripe group for all breakdown rows
    stripe_groups <- c(stripe_groups, rep(current_stripe, nrow(other_kmt2a_breakdown)))
  } else if (subtype == "MECOM rearrangement" && exists("mecom_breakdown")) {
    included_table_final <- rbind(included_table_final, mecom_breakdown)
    stripe_groups <- c(stripe_groups, rep(current_stripe, nrow(mecom_breakdown)))
  } else if (subtype == "AML with other rare recurring translocations" &&
             exists("other_rare_tx_breakdown")) {
    # Add expanded rows for rare translocations under the merged row
    included_table_final <- rbind(included_table_final, other_rare_tx_breakdown)
    stripe_groups <- c(stripe_groups, rep(current_stripe, nrow(other_rare_tx_breakdown)))
  }
  
  # Increment stripe for next group
  current_stripe <- current_stripe + 1
}

# Create excluded table, with rare recurrent translocations grouped
excluded_df_modified <- excluded_df
excluded_df_modified$Subtype_Merged <- excluded_df$Subtype
excluded_df_modified$Subtype_Merged[
  excluded_df_modified$Subtype %in% rare_tx_subtypes
] <- "other.rare.tx"

excluded_table <- create_subtype_table(
  data.frame(
    Subtype = excluded_df_modified$Subtype_Merged,
    Cohort = excluded_df_modified$Cohort
  ),
  cohort_order
)

# Rename merged rare group for excluded section as well
excluded_table$Subtype <- gsub(
  "other\\.rare\\.tx",
  "AML with other rare recurring translocations",
  excluded_table$Subtype
)

# Add Group column
included_table_final$Group <- "Included"
excluded_table$Group <- "Excluded"

# Add totals per study split by included/excluded
included_totals <- data.frame(
  Subtype = "Total",
  t(colSums(included_table_merged[, cohort_order])),  # Use merged table for correct totals
  Total = sum(included_table_merged$Total),
  Group = "Included",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(included_totals) <- c("Subtype", cohort_order, "Total", "Group")

excluded_totals <- data.frame(
  Subtype = "Total",
  t(colSums(excluded_table[, cohort_order])),
  Total = sum(excluded_table$Total),
  Group = "Excluded",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(excluded_totals) <- c("Subtype", cohort_order, "Total", "Group")

# Combine all tables
combined_table_with_totals <- rbind(
  included_table_final[, c("Group", "Subtype", cohort_order, "Total")],
  included_totals[, c("Group", "Subtype", cohort_order, "Total")],
  excluded_table[, c("Group", "Subtype", cohort_order, "Total")],
  excluded_totals[, c("Group", "Subtype", cohort_order, "Total")]
)
combined_table_with_totals$Group <- NULL

# Create formatted table with manual striping
table_output <- kable(combined_table_with_totals, 
      format = "html",
      caption = "Table 1: Distribution of Leukemia Subtypes by Cohort",
      row.names = FALSE, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left"
  )

# Apply manual striping for included rows
# Stripe colors for included section - merged classes share stripe with their breakdowns
for (i in 1:length(stripe_groups)) {
  stripe_color <- if (stripe_groups[i] %% 2 == 1) "#f9f9f9" else "white"
  table_output <- table_output %>%
    row_spec(i, background = stripe_color)
}

# Apply striping for excluded rows (standard alternating)
excluded_start <- nrow(included_table_final) + 2
excluded_end <- nrow(combined_table_with_totals) - 1
for (i in excluded_start:excluded_end) {
  row_index <- i - excluded_start + 1
  stripe_color <- if (row_index %% 2 == 1) "#f9f9f9" else "white"
  table_output <- table_output %>%
    row_spec(i, background = stripe_color)
}

# Add section headers and total row styling
table_output <- table_output %>%
  pack_rows("Included", 1, nrow(included_table_final)+1, 
            label_row_css = "background-color: #e6f2ff; font-weight: bold;", indent = F) %>%
  pack_rows("Excluded", excluded_start, nrow(combined_table_with_totals),
            label_row_css = "background-color: #ffe6e6; font-weight: bold;", indent = F) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Adult Cohorts" = 4, "Pediatric Cohorts" = 3, " " = 1))

table_output
save_kable(table_output, "../writing/tables_new/supplementary_table1.png", zoom = 2)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Build a sequential sample-count flow for cohort curation.
starting_n <- length(leukemia_subtypes)

keep_low_n <- leukemia_subtypes %in% subtypes_with_sufficient_samples
keep_not_missing <- leukemia_subtypes != "Missing data"
removed_missing <- sum(!keep_not_missing)

removed_low_n <- sum(keep_not_missing & !keep_low_n)

keep_not_nos <- leukemia_subtypes != "AML NOS"
removed_nos <- sum(keep_not_missing & keep_low_n & !keep_not_nos)

keep_not_multi <- leukemia_subtypes != "Multi"
removed_multi <- sum(keep_not_missing & keep_low_n & keep_not_nos & !keep_not_multi)

# Final set matches the filtered data used downstream (including selected studies).
final_train_test_n <- length(filter)

flow_nodes <- data.frame(
  x = 1,
  y = c(6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
  label = c(
    paste0("Starting data\nn = ", starting_n),
    paste0("Removed samples with missing data\nn removed = ", removed_missing),
    paste0("Removed samples with n<10 classes\nn removed = ", removed_low_n),
    paste0("Removed samples with AML, NOS\nn removed = ", removed_nos),
    paste0("Removed samples with multi RGAs\nn removed = ", removed_multi),
    paste0("Final training/test data\nn = ", final_train_test_n)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

flow_arrows <- data.frame(
  x = 1,
  xend = 1,
  y = c(5.62, 4.62, 3.62, 2.62, 1.62),
  yend = c(5.38, 4.38, 3.38, 2.38, 1.38)
)

side_nodes <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.9, 1.9),
  y = c(2.6, 3.9),
  label = c(
    "Used in follow-up analyses",
    "Used in reject option training and testing"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

followup_arrows <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.35, 1.35, 1.35),

  xend = c(1.84, 1.84, 1.84),
  yend = c(2.6, 2.6, 2.6),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

reject_lines <- data.frame(
  x = c(1.35, 1.35),
  y = c(4, 3),
  xend = c(1.84, 1.84),
  yend = c(3.9, 3.9),

)

ggplot() +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_nodes,

  ) +

  ) +
```

## -- patients and classes per age category
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Age in years (integer: one bar per year)
meta$age_years <- meta$age_days / 365.25
meta$age_int <- floor(meta$age_years)

age_summary <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_int)) %>%
  group_by(age_int) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients = n(),
    n_classes = n_distinct(classes),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

scale_factor <- max(age_summary$n_patients) / max(age_summary$n_classes)

p_dual <- ggplot(age_summary, aes(x = age_int)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n_patients), fill = "#7eb0d5", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.9) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n_classes * scale_factor), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = n_classes * scale_factor), color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Patients",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Unique Classes")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(age_summary$age_int), by = 10)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
```

```{r}
types <- c("cv", "loso")
models <- names(outer_merged$detailed_performance$cv)

# Helper: extract per-fold performance for a given result object and label set
get_results_per_fold <- function(res_obj, label_set) {
  out <- data.frame()
  for (type_i in types) {
    for (model_i in models) {
      folds <- names(res_obj$detailed_performance[[type_i]][[models[1]]])
      for (fold_i in folds) {
        out <- rbind(
          out,
          data.frame(
            type      = type_i,
            model     = model_i,
            fold      = fold_i,
            kappa     = res_obj$detailed_performance[[type_i]][[model_i]][[fold_i]][["kappa"]],
            accuracy  = res_obj$detailed_performance[[type_i]][[model_i]][[fold_i]][["accuracy"]],
            label_set = label_set,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }
  out
}
```

```{r}
# Summary heatmaps of mean and SD per model for CV and LOSO (including accuracy),
# now with separate columns for full vs collapsed label sets.
summary_stats <- results_per_fold %>%
  group_by(type, model, label_set) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_kappa    = mean(kappa),
    sd_kappa      = sd(kappa),
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    sd_accuracy   = sd(accuracy),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )

# Create table with mean (±SD) format directly from summary_stats
# Extract and rename columns for each combination of type and label_set
cv_full <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(type == "cv", label_set == "Full subtypes") %>%
  select(model, 
         cv_kappa_mean_full = mean_kappa, 
         cv_kappa_sd_full = sd_kappa,
         cv_acc_mean_full = mean_accuracy, 
         cv_acc_sd_full = sd_accuracy)

cv_collapsed <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(type == "cv", label_set == "Collapsed classes") %>%
  select(model,
         cv_kappa_mean_collapsed = mean_kappa,
         cv_kappa_sd_collapsed = sd_kappa,
         cv_acc_mean_collapsed = mean_accuracy,
         cv_acc_sd_collapsed = sd_accuracy)

loso_full <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(type == "loso", label_set == "Full subtypes") %>%
  select(model,
         loso_kappa_mean_full = mean_kappa,
         loso_kappa_sd_full = sd_kappa,
         loso_acc_mean_full = mean_accuracy,
         loso_acc_sd_full = sd_accuracy)

loso_collapsed <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(type == "loso", label_set == "Collapsed classes") %>%
  select(model,
         loso_kappa_mean_collapsed = mean_kappa,
         loso_kappa_sd_collapsed = sd_kappa,
         loso_acc_mean_collapsed = mean_accuracy,
         loso_acc_sd_collapsed = sd_accuracy)

# Join all data together
performance_table <- cv_full %>%
  left_join(cv_collapsed, by = "model") %>%
  left_join(loso_full, by = "model") %>%
  left_join(loso_collapsed, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    Model = model,
    `CV Kappa (Full)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", cv_kappa_mean_full, cv_kappa_sd_full),
    `CV Kappa (Collapsed)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", cv_kappa_mean_collapsed, cv_kappa_sd_collapsed),
    `CV Accuracy (Full)` = sprintf("%.1f%% ± %.1f%%", cv_acc_mean_full * 100, cv_acc_sd_full * 100),
    `CV Accuracy (Collapsed)` = sprintf("%.1f%% ± %.1f%%", cv_acc_mean_collapsed * 100, cv_acc_sd_collapsed * 100),
    `LOSO Kappa (Full)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", loso_kappa_mean_full, loso_kappa_sd_full),
    `LOSO Kappa (Collapsed)` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", loso_kappa_mean_collapsed, loso_kappa_sd_collapsed),
    `LOSO Accuracy (Full)` = sprintf("%.1f%% ± %.1f%%", loso_acc_mean_full * 100, loso_acc_sd_full * 100),
    `LOSO Accuracy (Collapsed)` = sprintf("%.1f%% ± %.1f%%", loso_acc_mean_collapsed * 100, loso_acc_sd_collapsed * 100)
  ) %>%
  select(Model, `CV Kappa (Full)`, `CV Kappa (Collapsed)`, `CV Accuracy (Full)`, 
         `CV Accuracy (Collapsed)`, `LOSO Kappa (Full)`, `LOSO Kappa (Collapsed)`, 
         `LOSO Accuracy (Full)`, `LOSO Accuracy (Collapsed)`)

# Order by cv_order (reverse order to match original)
performance_table <- performance_table %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = cv_order)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Model)) %>%
  mutate(Model = as.character(Model))

# Display table using kable
```

```{r}
# Global_Optimized is best
fix_names <- function(x){
  # Map verbose labels to concise AML names; preserves factor inputs by relabeling levels

  if (is.factor(x)) {
    new_levels <- vapply(levels(x), function(l) {
      val <- unname(mapping[l])
      if (is.na(val)) l else val
    }, character(1))
    levels(x) <- new_levels
    return(x)
  } else {
    y <- vapply(as.character(x), function(l) {
      val <- unname(mapping[l])
      if (is.na(val)) l else val
    }, character(1))
    return(y)
  }
}

make_cm_fig <- function(res_obj, type, label_set) {
  # All per-class summaries for a given result object (full vs collapsed)
  per_class <- res_obj$per_class_summaries[[type]]
  per_class <- per_class[per_class$Model == "Global_Optimized", ]
  rownames(per_class) <- gsub("Class: ", "", per_class$Class)

  # Apply pretty names to per-class row labels
  rownames(per_class) <- fix_names(rownames(per_class))

  # Get subtypes that exist in both per_class and order_AML, preserving order_AML order
  available_subtypes <- intersect(order_AML, rownames(per_class))
  # if (length(available_subtypes) < lenght(order_AML)){
  #   print("SOmething wrong with n classes")
  # }
  per_class <- per_class[available_subtypes, c(
    "Mean_F1",
    "Mean_Sensitivity",
    "Mean_Specificity",
    "Mean_Precision",
    "Mean_Recall"
  )]
  colnames(per_class) <- gsub("Mean_", "", colnames(per_class))
  print(sum(per_class$F1 > 0.8, na.rm = T))
  print(sum(per_class$F1 > 0.9, na.rm = T))
  
per_class[,1][is.na(per_class[,1])] <- 0

per_class <- apply(per_class, 2, function(x) round(x, 2))
  normalise <- function(x) {
    (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  }
  per_class_norm <- apply(per_class, 2, normalise)

  # Confusion matrices across folds for the same result object
  conf_table <- list()
  for (fold in names(res_obj$detailed_performance[[type]]$Global_Optimized)) {
      conf_table[[fold]] <- res_obj$detailed_performance[[type]]$Global_Optimized[[fold]]$confusion_matrix$table
  }

  # Get all unique classes across all folds
  all_classes <- unique(unlist(lapply(conf_table, function(x) c(rownames(x), colnames(x)))))

  # Pad each confusion matrix to have the same dimensions
  conf_table_padded <- lapply(conf_table, function(mat) {
    padded_mat <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow    = length(all_classes),
      ncol    = length(all_classes),
      dimnames = list(all_classes, all_classes)
    )
    padded_mat[rownames(mat), colnames(mat)] <- mat
    padded_mat
  })

  total_conf <- Reduce("+", conf_table_padded)
  total_conf <- t(total_conf)

  # Apply pretty names to confusion matrix axes and reorder to match per_class
  rownames(total_conf) <- fix_names(rownames(total_conf))
  colnames(total_conf) <- fix_names(colnames(total_conf))
  total_conf <- total_conf[rownames(per_class), rownames(per_class)]

  # LOSO: drop classes with no samples in any fold (0 row sum)
  if (type == "loso") {
    keep <- rowSums(total_conf) > 0
    total_conf    <- total_conf[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
    per_class     <- per_class[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    per_class_norm <- per_class_norm[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Per-class heatmap (built after LOSO filter so row count matches confusion matrix)
  palette_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "green4"))
  ht_per_class <- Heatmap(
    per_class,
    name              = NULL,
    row_names_side    = "left",
    column_names_side = "top",
    row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,
    cluster_columns   = FALSE,
    rect_gp           = gpar(col = "#d9d9d9", lwd = 0.5),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      val      <- per_class[i, j]
      norm_val <- per_class_norm[i, j]
      grid.rect(
        x,
        y,
        width  = width,
        height = height,
        gp     = gpar(
          fill = palette_fun(val),
          col  = "#d9d9d9",
          lwd  = 0.5
        )
      )
      grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", val), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))
    },
    show_heatmap_legend  = FALSE,
    column_names_rot     = 45,
    column_names_centered = FALSE,
    column_title         = "Performance measure",
    column_title_gp      = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
    row_title            = "Reference class",
    row_title_gp         = gpar(fontface = "bold")
  )

  # Row-normalise so colour = proportion of that reference class in each predicted class.
  # Diagonal then = recall per class, comparable across small and large classes.
  row_sums <- rowSums(total_conf)
  row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1
  total_conf_norm <- total_conf / row_sums

  total_conf_palette_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "purple3"))
  ht_table <- Heatmap(
    total_conf,
    name              = NULL,
    row_names_side    = "left",
    column_names_side = "top",
    row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,
    cluster_columns   = FALSE,
    rect_gp           = gpar(col = "#d9d9d9", lwd = 0.5),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      val      <- total_conf[i, j]
      norm_val <- total_conf_norm[i, j]
      grid.rect(
        x,
        y,
        width  = width,
        height = height,
        gp     = gpar(
          fill = total_conf_palette_fun(norm_val),
          col  = "#d9d9d9",
          lwd  = 0.5
        )
      )
      grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", val), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))
    },
    show_heatmap_legend  = FALSE,
    column_names_rot     = 45,
    column_names_centered = FALSE,
    column_title         = "Predicted class",
    column_title_gp      = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
    row_title            = "Reference class",
    row_title_gp         = gpar(fontface = "bold")
  )

  ht_per_class + ht_table
}

# Build class-performance + confusion-matrix composites for both full and collapsed label sets
cm_fig_cv_full       <- make_cm_fig(outer_unmerged, "cv",   "Full subtypes")
cm_fig_loso_full     <- make_cm_fig(outer_unmerged, "loso", "Full subtypes")
cm_fig_cv_collapsed  <- make_cm_fig(outer_merged,   "cv",   "Collapsed classes")
cm_fig_loso_collapsed <- make_cm_fig(outer_merged,  "loso", "Collapsed classes")

# Wrap as ggplot objects with informative titles
cm_fig_cv_full_plot <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(function() {
```

```{r}
      Class %in% c("Mutated NPM1", "CEBPA bZIP in-frame") ~ "Major mutations",

# For Panel A: show only Full dot for classes unchanged between Full and Merged; merged groups keep Merged point
```

```{r}
make_axis_labels <- function(class_levels) {
  lbl <- sapply(class_levels, function(cls) {
    safe_cls <- gsub(";", ", ", cls, fixed = TRUE)
    if (cls %in% c("Other KMT2A rearrangements", "MDS-related", "MECOM rearrangement")) {
      paste0("<i>", safe_cls, "</i>")
    } else {
      safe_cls
    }
  })
  names(lbl) <- class_levels
  lbl
}

make_split_panel <- function(df, panel_title) {
  axis_class_levels_local <- levels(df$Class)
  axis_class_levels_local <- axis_class_levels_local[axis_class_levels_local %in% unique(df$Class)]

  cls_to_cat_local <- setNames(
    as.character(df$Category[match(axis_class_levels_local, df$Class)]),
    axis_class_levels_local
  )
  cls_to_cat_local[is.na(cls_to_cat_local)] <- "Other"
  axis_text_colors_local <- setNames(category_colors[cls_to_cat_local], axis_class_levels_local)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = F1, y = Class, color = Category, shape = ShapeType)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = category_colors, name = "Category", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_values, labels = shape_labels, name = "Classes", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = make_axis_labels(axis_class_levels_local)) +
    labs(x = "F1 Score", y = "", title = panel_title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 8, color = axis_text_colors_local),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_markdown(size = 8),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1.0)
}

panel_a_full_split <- make_split_panel(
```

```{r}
# Panel B & C: Error Heatmaps for KMT2A and MDS groups
# Function to extract and prepare confusion matrix for specific groups
get_error_heatmap <- function(res_obj, type, label_set, focus_groups) {
  # Get confusion matrices across folds
  conf_table <- list()
  
  # Determine model name - check what's available
  model_name <- "Global_Optimized"
  
  if (is.null(model_name) || !model_name %in% names(res_obj$detailed_performance[[type]])) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  for (fold in names(res_obj$detailed_performance[[type]][[model_name]])) {
    cm_obj <- res_obj$detailed_performance[[type]][[model_name]][[fold]]$confusion_matrix
    if (!is.null(cm_obj) && !is.null(cm_obj$table)) {
      conf_table[[fold]] <- cm_obj$table
    }
  }
  
  if (length(conf_table) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get all unique classes
  all_classes <- unique(unlist(lapply(conf_table, function(x) c(rownames(x), colnames(x)))))
  
  if (length(all_classes) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Pad each confusion matrix
  conf_table_padded <- lapply(conf_table, function(mat) {
    padded_mat <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow = length(all_classes),
      ncol = length(all_classes),
      dimnames = list(all_classes, all_classes)
    )
    padded_mat[rownames(mat), colnames(mat)] <- mat
    padded_mat
  })
  
  # Sum across folds
  total_conf <- Reduce("+", conf_table_padded)
  total_conf <- t(total_conf)
  
  # Apply pretty names
  rownames(total_conf) <- fix_names(rownames(total_conf))
  colnames(total_conf) <- fix_names(colnames(total_conf))
  
  # Filter to focus groups - show square matrix of focus classes
  focus_classes <- intersect(focus_groups, rownames(total_conf))
  
  if (length(focus_classes) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Show square matrix: focus classes as both rows and columns
  # This shows errors between the focus classes themselves
  conf_focused <- total_conf[focus_classes, focus_classes, drop = FALSE]

  # Check for off-diagonal errors
  off_diag <- conf_focused
  diag(off_diag) <- 0
  
  # Calculate row percentages (error rates)
  row_sums <- rowSums(conf_focused)
  conf_percent <- sweep(conf_focused, 1, row_sums, "/") * 100
  conf_percent[is.nan(conf_percent)] <- 0
  
  return(list(
    counts = conf_focused,
    percentages = conf_percent,
    label_set = label_set
  ))
}

# Define focus groups for KMT2A, MDS, and MECOM
# Panel B: Full classes shown separately
kmt2a_mllt3 <- "MLLT3::KMT2A"
kmt2a_other_full <- c("KMT2A::ELL", "KMT2A::MLLT10", "KMT2A::MLLT1", "KMT2A::MLLT4", "KMT2A::SEPT6")
mds_groups_full <- c("MDS-related, gene mutations", "MDS-related, TP53 mutated", "MDS-related, cytogenetic abnormalities")
mecom_groups_full <- c("GATA2;MECOM", "MECOM, other")

# Panel C: KMT2A::MLLT3 separate, other KMT2A combined, MDS combined, MECOM combined
kmt2a_other_merged <- "Other KMT2A rearrangements"
mds_merged <- "MDS-related"
mecom_merged <- "MECOM rearrangement"

# Combine groups for each panel
focus_groups_panel_b <- c(kmt2a_mllt3, kmt2a_other_full, mecom_groups_full, mds_groups_full)
focus_groups_panel_c <- c(kmt2a_mllt3, kmt2a_other_merged, mecom_merged, mds_merged)

# Get error heatmaps from appropriate result objects
# Panel B uses full classes (outer_unmerged), Panel C uses collapsed classes (outer_merged)
error_panel_b <- get_error_heatmap(outer_unmerged, "cv", "Full", focus_groups_panel_b)
error_panel_c <- get_error_heatmap(outer_merged, "cv", "Collapsed", focus_groups_panel_c)

# Shared styling for both error heatmaps (same cell size and font sizes)
error_heatmap_cell_w_mm <- 12*0.6
error_heatmap_cell_h_mm <- 6*0.6
error_heatmap_font_rowcol <- 7
error_heatmap_font_cell_diag <- 6
error_heatmap_font_cell_off <- 5
error_heatmap_font_title <- 9
error_heatmap_font_legend <- 7

# Shared colour scale so legends merge when combined
error_heatmap_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 100), c("white", "purple3"))
error_heatmap_group_cols <- c("KMT2A::MLLT3" = "#1f77b4", "Other KMT2A" = "#ff7f0e", "MECOM rearrangement" = "#17becf", "MDS-related" = "#d62728")

# Create heatmap function with group annotations; accepts optional font/cell size overrides for combined figures
create_error_heatmap <- function(error_data, title, other_kmt2a_classes, mds_classes, mecom_classes = NULL,
    name = "heatmap",
    cell_w_mm = error_heatmap_cell_w_mm, cell_h_mm = error_heatmap_cell_h_mm,
    font_rowcol = error_heatmap_font_rowcol, font_cell_diag = error_heatmap_font_cell_diag,
    font_cell_off = error_heatmap_font_cell_off, font_title = error_heatmap_font_title,
    font_legend = error_heatmap_font_legend, col_fun = error_heatmap_col_fun) {
  if (is.null(error_data)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  conf_percent <- error_data$percentages

  # Group per row (for y-axis text colour and for legend)
  group_anno <- sapply(rownames(conf_percent), function(rname) {
    if (rname == "MLLT3::KMT2A") return("KMT2A::MLLT3")
    if (rname %in% other_kmt2a_classes) return("Other KMT2A")
    if (!is.null(mecom_classes) && rname %in% mecom_classes) return("MECOM rearrangement")
    if (rname %in% mds_classes) return("MDS-related")
    return("Other")
  })
  row_name_colors <- error_heatmap_group_cols[group_anno]
  row_name_colors[is.na(row_name_colors)] <- "gray40"

  nrc <- nrow(conf_percent)
  ncc <- ncol(conf_percent)

  ht <- Heatmap(
    conf_percent,
    name = name,
    col = col_fun,
    width = unit(ncc * cell_w_mm, "mm"),
    height = unit(nrc * cell_h_mm, "mm"),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    column_names_side = "top",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = font_rowcol, col = row_name_colors),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = font_rowcol),
    column_names_rot = 45,
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      count <- error_data$counts[i, j]
      grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = "#d9d9d9", lwd = 0.5))
      if (i == j) {
        grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", count), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = font_cell_diag, fontface = "bold"))
      } else if (count > 0) {
        grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", count), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = font_cell_off))
      }
    },
    column_title = title,
    column_title_side = "bottom",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = font_title, fontface = "bold"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "% of row",
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = font_legend),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = font_legend - 1),
      direction = "horizontal"
    )
  )

  return(ht)
}

# Build both heatmaps with identical cell size and fonts (no padding)
ht_error_full <- create_error_heatmap(
  error_panel_b,
  "Full classes",
  other_kmt2a_classes = kmt2a_other_full,
  mds_classes = mds_groups_full,
  mecom_classes = mecom_groups_full,
  name = "Full"
)
ht_error_merged <- create_error_heatmap(

  "Collapsed classes",
  other_kmt2a_classes = kmt2a_other_merged,
  mds_classes = mds_merged,
  mecom_classes = mecom_merged,
  name = "Collapsed"
)

# Padding: bottom, left, top, right (extra right so diagonal and column labels are not clipped)
heatmap_padding <- unit(c(8, 8, 8, 18), "mm")

# Left: full classes (no legend)
A <- ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_error_full,
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_legend = FALSE,

) |> grid.grabExpr()

# Right: merged classes (with % of row legend)
B <- ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_error_merged,
```

## -- Faceted Confusion Matrices per Fold


```{r}
# Function to create faceted confusion matrices per fold
make_faceted_cm <- function(type) {
  # Get all folds for this type
  folds <- names(outer_merged$detailed_performance[[type]]$Global_Optimized)
  # Per class
  per_class_list <- list()
  # Collect confusion matrices for all folds
  conf_matrices <- list()
  for (fold in folds) {
    per_class <- outer_unmerged$detailed_performance[[type]]$svm[[fold]]$confusion_matrix$byClass
    rownames(per_class) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(per_class))
    rownames(per_class) <- fix_names(rownames(per_class))
    
    cm <- outer_unmerged$detailed_performance[[type]]$svm[[fold]]$confusion_matrix$table
    cm <- t(cm)  # Transpose to match convention (rows = reference, cols = prediction)
    
    
    # Apply pretty names
    rownames(cm) <- fix_names(rownames(cm))
    colnames(cm) <- fix_names(colnames(cm))
    
    # Reorder to match standard order
    all_classes <- intersect(order_AML, unique(c(
      rownames(per_class))))
    per_class <- per_class[all_classes, c("F1", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "Recall")]
    #to_remove <- apply(per_class, 1, function(x)
    #  any(is.na(x)))
    #per_class <- per_class[!to_remove, ]
    cm <- cm[rownames(per_class), rownames(per_class), drop = FALSE]

    # LOSO: drop reference classes with no samples in this fold
    if (type == "loso") {
      keep <- rowSums(cm) > 0
      cm <- cm[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
      per_class <- per_class[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    }

    normalise <- function(x) {
      return((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
    }
    per_class_norm <- apply(per_class, 2, normalise)

    # Row-normalise for colour: proportion of each reference class in each predicted class (diagonal = recall).
    rs <- rowSums(cm)
    rs[rs == 0] <- 1
    cm_norm <- cm / rs

    conf_matrices[[fold]] <- list(matrix = cm,
                                  normalized = cm_norm,
                                  per_class = per_class,
                                  per_class_norm = per_class_norm,
                                  fold_name = fold)
  }
  
  # Define palette for confusion matrices (white to purple)
  total_conf_palette_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "purple3"))
  
  # Define palette for per-class metrics (white to green for performance)
  palette_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "green4"))
  
  # Create individual heatmaps for each fold
  heatmaps <- list()
  
  for (fold in folds) {
    cm_data <- conf_matrices[[fold]]
    per_class <- cm_data$per_class
    per_class_norm <- cm_data$per_class_norm
    ht_per_class <- Heatmap(
      per_class,
      name = NULL,
      row_names_side = "left",
      column_names_side = "top",
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      rect_gp = gpar(col = "#d9d9d9", lwd = 0.5),
      cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
        val <- per_class[i, j]
        norm_val <- per_class_norm[i, j]
        grid.rect(
          x,
          y,
          width = width,
          height = height,
          gp = gpar(
            fill = palette_fun(val),
            col = "#d9d9d9",
            lwd = 0.5
          )
        )
        grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", val), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))
      },
      show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
      column_names_rot = 45,
      column_names_centered = F,
      column_title = "Performance measure",
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
      row_title = "Reference class",
      row_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")
    )
    ht <- Heatmap(
      cm_data$matrix,
      name = NULL,
      row_names_side = "left",
      column_names_side = "top",
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      rect_gp = gpar(col = "#d9d9d9", lwd = 0.3),
      cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
        val <- cm_data$matrix[i, j]
        norm_val <- cm_data$normalized[i, j]
        grid.rect(
          x,
          y,
          width = width,
          height = height,
          gp = gpar(
            fill = total_conf_palette_fun(norm_val),
            col = "#d9d9d9",
            lwd = 0.3
          )
        )
        if (val > 0) {
          grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", val), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
        }
      },
      show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
      column_names_rot = 45,
      column_names_centered = FALSE,
      column_title = paste0("Predicted class for fold: ", cm_data$fold_name),
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
      row_title = "Reference",
      row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold")
    )
    
    heatmaps[[fold]] <- ht_per_class+ht
  }
  
  return(heatmaps)
}
```

```{r}
# Define pediatric cohorts for color coding
pediatric_cohorts <- c("AAML0531", "AAML1031", "AAML03P1")

# Helper function to order folds by mean kappa and create color vector for x-axis labels
prepare_fold_data <- function(data_subset) {
  fold_means <- data_subset %>% filter(model %in% c("Global Ensemble", "Ensemble")) %>%
    group_by(fold) %>%
    summarise(mean_kappa = mean(kappa), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(mean_kappa)
  
  data_subset$fold <- factor(data_subset$fold, levels = fold_means$fold)
  fold_order <- levels(data_subset$fold)
  label_colors <- ifelse(fold_order %in% pediatric_cohorts, "#fd7f6f", "#7eb0d5")
  
  return(list(data = data_subset, label_colors = label_colors))
}
```

## -- Visualization: Age Effect on Performance

```{r}
# Build age-kappa plots for LOSO and standard CV in one place:
# collapsed classes + full classes, while keeping legacy object names.

build_sample_level_df <- function(res_obj, setting = c("loso", "cv"), collapsed = TRUE) {
  setting <- match.arg(setting)
  predictions_list <- list()
  truth_list <- list()
  indices_list <- list()
  fold_list <- list()

  for (fold in names(res_obj$detailed_performance[[setting]]$Global_Optimized)) {
    fold_prob_matrix <- res_obj$ensemble_matrices[[setting]]$global_ensemble[[fold]]

    # Keep only class-probability columns when deriving predicted label.
    non_class_cols <- c("y", "outer_fold", "fold", "sample_indices", "sample_index")
    class_cols <- colnames(fold_prob_matrix)[!colnames(fold_prob_matrix) %in% non_class_cols]
    pred_idx <- apply(fold_prob_matrix[, class_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, which.max)
    predictions <- class_cols[pred_idx]
    truth <- as.character(fold_prob_matrix$y)

    # Prefer sample_indices; fall back to sample_index if needed.
    sample_indices <- if ("sample_indices" %in% colnames(fold_prob_matrix)) {
      fold_prob_matrix$sample_indices
    } else {
      fold_prob_matrix$sample_index
    }

    predictions_list[[fold]] <- predictions
    truth_list[[fold]] <- truth
    indices_list[[fold]] <- sample_indices
    fold_list[[fold]] <- rep(fold, length(predictions))
  }

  out <- data.frame(
    prediction = unlist(predictions_list),
    truth = unlist(truth_list),
    fold = unlist(fold_list),
    sample_index = unlist(indices_list),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out$correct <- out$prediction == out$truth
  out$age_days <- meta$age_days[out$sample_index + 1]
  out$age_years <- out$age_days / 365.25

  if (collapsed) {
    out$truth_display <- fix_names(modify_classes(out$truth))
    out$prediction_display <- fix_names(modify_classes(out$prediction))
  } else {
    out$truth_display <- fix_names(out$truth)
    out$prediction_display <- fix_names(out$prediction)
  }

  out
}

build_age_kappa <- function(df, min_n = 5) {
  age_bins <- seq(0, 90, by = 4)
  age_perf <- data.frame()

  for (i in 1:(length(age_bins) - 1)) {
    age_min <- age_bins[i]
    age_max <- age_bins[i + 1]
    subset_data <- df[df$age_years >= age_min & df$age_years < age_max, ]

    if (nrow(subset_data) >= min_n) {
      cm_levels <- unique(c(subset_data$truth_display, subset_data$prediction_display))
      cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(
        factor(subset_data$prediction_display, levels = cm_levels),
        factor(subset_data$truth_display, levels = cm_levels)
      )

      age_perf <- rbind(age_perf, data.frame(
        age_mid = (age_min + age_max) / 2,
        age_label = sprintf("%d-%d", age_min, age_max),
        n = nrow(subset_data),
        accuracy = mean(subset_data$correct),
        kappa = as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"]),
        se_accuracy = sd(subset_data$correct) / sqrt(nrow(subset_data))
      ))
    }
  }

  age_perf
}

plot_age_kappa <- function(age_perf, point_color, subtitle_text) {
  ggplot(age_perf, aes(x = age_mid, y = kappa)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.7, color = point_color) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = point_color, fill = point_color,
                alpha = 0.2, formula = y ~ x) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 18, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 18, y = min(age_perf$kappa) - 0.02,
             label = "Pediatric/Adult\nBoundary", vjust = 1, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6), name = "Sample Size") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Performance by Patient Age", subtitle = subtitle_text, x = "Age (years)", y = "Kappa") +
    ylim(0.6, 1) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 10))
}

# Build sample-level data for each setting/label definition.
sample_level_df <- build_sample_level_df(outer_merged, setting = "loso", collapsed = TRUE)
sample_level_age <- sample_level_df
sample_level_df_cv <- build_sample_level_df(outer_merged, setting = "cv", collapsed = TRUE)

sample_level_df_cv_full <- build_sample_level_df(outer_unmerged, setting = "cv", collapsed = FALSE)
```

## -- Per-Subtype F1 by Age Analysis

```{r}
# Calculate F1 per subtype per 15-year age bin
age_bins_5yr <- seq(0, 90, by = 10)
subtypes_unique <- unique(sample_level_age$truth_display)
f1_by_age_subtype <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:(length(age_bins_5yr)-1)) {
  age_min <- age_bins_5yr[i]
  age_max <- age_bins_5yr[i+1]
  age_mid <- (age_min + age_max) / 2
  age_label <- sprintf("%d-%d", age_min, age_max)
  
  age_bin_data <- sample_level_age[sample_level_age$age_years >= age_min & 
                                     sample_level_age$age_years < age_max, ]
  if (nrow(age_bin_data) == 0) next
  
  for (subtype_i in subtypes_unique) {
    tp <- sum(age_bin_data$truth_display == subtype_i & age_bin_data$prediction_display == subtype_i)
    fp <- sum(age_bin_data$truth_display != subtype_i & age_bin_data$prediction_display == subtype_i)
    fn <- sum(age_bin_data$truth_display == subtype_i & age_bin_data$prediction_display != subtype_i)
    n_true <- sum(age_bin_data$truth_display == subtype_i)
    
    if (n_true >= 5) {
      precision <- ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA)
      recall <- ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA)
      f1_score <- ifelse(!is.na(precision) & !is.na(recall) & (precision + recall) > 0,
                         2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), NA)
      
      f1_by_age_subtype <- rbind(f1_by_age_subtype, data.frame(
        age_bin = age_label, age_min = age_min, age_max = age_max, age_mid = age_mid,
        truth_display = subtype_i, n = n_true, tp = tp, fp = fp, fn = fn,
        precision = precision, recall = recall, f1_score = f1_score
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Filter to subtypes with data across multiple age ranges
subtypes_multi_age <- f1_by_age_subtype %>%
  group_by(truth_display) %>%
  summarise(n_age_bins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_age_bins >= 1)

f1_by_age_plot <- f1_by_age_subtype %>%

# Faceted plot
p_f1_age_subtype_facet <- ggplot(f1_by_age_plot, aes(x = age_mid, y = f1_score)) +
```

## -- Data Preparation: Subtype Enrichment Analysis

```{r}
# Get F1 scores per subtype from per-class summaries
per_class_f1 <- outer_merged$per_class_summaries$cv %>%
  filter(Model == "Global_Optimized") %>%
  select(Class, Mean_F1)
per_class_f1$Class <- gsub("Class: ", "", per_class_f1$Class)
per_class_f1$Class <- fix_names(per_class_f1$Class)

# Analyze subtype distribution in pediatric vs adult samples
subtype_enrichment <- sample_level_age %>%
  group_by(truth_display) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pediatric = sum(is_pediatric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_adult = sum(!is_pediatric, na.rm = TRUE),
    accuracy_pediatric = ifelse(
      sum(is_pediatric, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      mean(correct[is_pediatric], na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    accuracy_adult = ifelse(
      sum(!is_pediatric, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      mean(correct[!is_pediatric], na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge with F1 scores and calculate enrichment
subtype_enrichment <- merge(subtype_enrichment, per_class_f1, 
                            by.x = "truth_display", by.y = "Class", all.x = TRUE)

total_adult <- sum(subtype_enrichment$n_adult)
total_pediatric <- sum(subtype_enrichment$n_pediatric)
subtype_enrichment$prop_adult <- subtype_enrichment$n_adult / total_adult
subtype_enrichment$prop_pediatric <- subtype_enrichment$n_pediatric / total_pediatric
subtype_enrichment$enrichment_ratio <- (subtype_enrichment$prop_pediatric + 0.001) / 
                                       (subtype_enrichment$prop_adult + 0.001)
subtype_enrichment$overall_accuracy <- 
  (subtype_enrichment$n_adult * subtype_enrichment$accuracy_adult + 
   subtype_enrichment$n_pediatric * subtype_enrichment$accuracy_pediatric) /
  (subtype_enrichment$n_adult + subtype_enrichment$n_pediatric)

# Chi-square/Fisher tests for enrichment classification
subtype_enrichment$chi_sq_p <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(subtype_enrichment)) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(subtype_enrichment$n_pediatric[i], 
                         total_pediatric - subtype_enrichment$n_pediatric[i],
                         subtype_enrichment$n_adult[i], 
                         total_adult - subtype_enrichment$n_adult[i]),
                       nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  test_result <- fisher.test(cont_table)
  subtype_enrichment$chi_sq_p[i] <- test_result$p.value
}
subtype_enrichment$chi_sq_p_adj <- p.adjust(subtype_enrichment$chi_sq_p, method = "BH")
subtype_enrichment$enrichment_class <- ifelse(
  subtype_enrichment$enrichment_ratio > 1, "Pediatric-enriched",
"Adult-enriched"
)

# Label samples by enrichment class
sample_level_age$subtype_enrichment <- subtype_enrichment$enrichment_class[
  match(sample_level_age$truth_display, subtype_enrichment$truth_display)
]
```


## -- Data Preparation: Per-Class F1 by Cohort Type

```{r}
# Function to calculate F1 for a specific subtype and cohort subset
calc_f1_for_subset <- function(data_subset, subtype_name, all_data) {
  if (nrow(data_subset) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  n_total <- nrow(data_subset)
  n_correct <- sum(data_subset$prediction_display == data_subset$truth_display)
  sensitivity <- n_correct / n_total
  
  n_predicted_as_this <- sum(all_data$prediction_display == subtype_name)
  if (n_predicted_as_this > 0) {
    n_correct_total <- sum(all_data$prediction_display == subtype_name & 
                           all_data$truth_display == subtype_name)
    precision <- n_correct_total / n_predicted_as_this
    f1 <- if (precision + sensitivity > 0) 2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity) else 0
  } else {
    precision <- 0
    f1 <- 0
  }
  
  list(n = n_total, sensitivity = sensitivity, precision = precision, f1 = f1, n_correct = n_correct)
}

# Calculate F1 per class per cohort type
f1_per_class_cohort_list <- list()

for (subtype in unique(sample_level_age$truth_display)) {
  subset_all <- sample_level_age[sample_level_age$truth_display == subtype, ]
  if (nrow(subset_all) < 5) next
  
  subset_ped <- subset_all[subset_all$is_pediatric == TRUE, ]
  subset_adult <- subset_all[subset_all$is_pediatric == FALSE, ]
  all_ped <- sample_level_age[sample_level_age$is_pediatric == TRUE, ]
  all_adult <- sample_level_age[sample_level_age$is_pediatric == FALSE, ]
  
  if (nrow(subset_ped) >= 5) {
    metrics_ped <- calc_f1_for_subset(subset_ped, subtype, all_ped)
    if (!is.null(metrics_ped)) {
      f1_per_class_cohort_list[[length(f1_per_class_cohort_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        subtype = subtype, is_pediatric = TRUE, cohort_type = "Pediatric",
        n = metrics_ped$n, sensitivity = metrics_ped$sensitivity,
        precision = metrics_ped$precision, f1 = metrics_ped$f1, n_correct = metrics_ped$n_correct
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(subset_adult) >= 5) {
    metrics_adult <- calc_f1_for_subset(subset_adult, subtype, all_adult)
    if (!is.null(metrics_adult)) {
      f1_per_class_cohort_list[[length(f1_per_class_cohort_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        subtype = subtype, is_pediatric = FALSE, cohort_type = "Adult",
        n = metrics_adult$n, sensitivity = metrics_adult$sensitivity,
        precision = metrics_adult$precision, f1 = metrics_adult$f1, n_correct = metrics_adult$n_correct
      )
    }
  }
}

f1_per_class_cohort <- do.call(rbind, f1_per_class_cohort_list)
f1_per_class_cohort <- merge(f1_per_class_cohort,
  subtype_enrichment[, c("truth_display", "enrichment_class", "n_pediatric", "n_adult")],
  by.x = "subtype", by.y = "truth_display", all.x = TRUE)

# Filter to enriched classes and sort by mean F1
f1_per_class_enriched <- f1_per_class_cohort[
  f1_per_class_cohort$enrichment_class %in% c("Adult-enriched", "Pediatric-enriched"), ]

f1_avg <- f1_per_class_enriched %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  summarise(avg_f1 = mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

f1_per_class_enriched <- merge(f1_per_class_enriched, f1_avg, by = "subtype")
f1_per_class_enriched <- f1_per_class_enriched[order(f1_per_class_enriched$avg_f1), ]
f1_per_class_enriched$subtype <- factor(f1_per_class_enriched$subtype, 
                                        levels = unique(f1_per_class_enriched$subtype))
```

## -- Visualization: F1 Scores per LOSO Fold (Full vs Merged)

```{r}
# Minimum number of samples per subtype in a fold to show that fold's F1 (avoids unstable F1 from tiny n)
min_n_per_subtype_in_fold <- 5L

# Extract per-fold F1 scores for both full and merged classes
# Helper function to get per-class F1 per fold for LOSO (includes n = count of subtype in fold)
get_f1_per_fold_loso <- function(res_obj, label_set_name) {
  folds <- names(res_obj$detailed_performance$loso$svm)
  f1_list <- list()
  
  for (fold in folds) {
    # Get predictions and truth for this fold
    fold_perf <- res_obj$detailed_performance$loso$Global_Optimized[[fold]]
    predictions <- fold_perf$predictions
    truth <- fold_perf$truth
    
    # Calculate F1 per class for this fold
    classes <- unique(c(as.character(predictions), as.character(truth)))
    
    for (cls in classes) {
      tp <- sum(truth == cls & predictions == cls)
      fp <- sum(truth != cls & predictions == cls)
      fn <- sum(truth == cls & predictions != cls)
      n_in_fold <- sum(truth == cls)  # number of samples of this subtype in this fold
      
      precision <- ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), 0)
      recall <- ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), 0)
      f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall > 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 0)
      
      f1_list[[length(f1_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        fold = fold,
        class = cls,
        f1 = f1,
        n_in_fold = n_in_fold,
        label_set = label_set_name,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, f1_list)
}

# Get F1 per fold for both full and merged
f1_full_loso <- get_f1_per_fold_loso(outer_unmerged, "Full subtypes")
f1_merged_loso <- get_f1_per_fold_loso(outer_merged, "Collapsed classes")

# Clean class names
f1_full_loso$class <- fix_names(f1_full_loso$class)
f1_merged_loso$class <- fix_names(f1_merged_loso$class)

# Combine datasets
f1_loso_combined <- rbind(f1_full_loso, f1_merged_loso)
f1_loso_combined$label_set <- factor(f1_loso_combined$label_set, 
                                     levels = c("Full subtypes", "Collapsed classes"))

# Keep only (fold, class) rows where subtype has at least min_n samples in that fold
f1_loso_combined <- f1_loso_combined %>% filter(n_in_fold >= min_n_per_subtype_in_fold)

# CV analogue: per-class F1 per outer fold (for F1 vs n and other analyses)
get_f1_per_fold_cv <- function(res_obj, label_set_name) {
  folds <- names(res_obj$detailed_performance$cv$Global_Optimized)
  f1_list <- list()
  for (fold in folds) {
    fold_perf <- res_obj$detailed_performance$cv$Global_Optimized[[fold]]
    predictions <- fold_perf$predictions
    truth <- fold_perf$truth
    classes <- unique(c(as.character(predictions), as.character(truth)))
    for (cls in classes) {
      tp <- sum(truth == cls & predictions == cls)
      fp <- sum(truth != cls & predictions == cls)
      fn <- sum(truth == cls & predictions != cls)
      n_in_fold <- sum(truth == cls)
      precision <- ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), 0)
      recall <- ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), 0)
      f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall > 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 0)
      f1_list[[length(f1_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        fold = fold, class = cls, f1 = f1, n_in_fold = n_in_fold,
        label_set = label_set_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, f1_list)
}
f1_full_cv <- get_f1_per_fold_cv(outer_unmerged, "Full subtypes")
f1_merged_cv <- get_f1_per_fold_cv(outer_merged, "Collapsed classes")
f1_full_cv$class <- fix_names(f1_full_cv$class)
f1_merged_cv$class <- fix_names(f1_merged_cv$class)
f1_cv_combined <- rbind(f1_full_cv, f1_merged_cv)
f1_cv_combined$label_set <- factor(f1_cv_combined$label_set, levels = c("Full subtypes", "Collapsed classes"))
f1_cv_combined <- f1_cv_combined %>% filter(n_in_fold >= min_n_per_subtype_in_fold)
```

# Gene selection analysis

```{r}
counts <- data.table::fread("../data/counts_20aug25.csv", drop = 1)
counts <- data.frame(data.table::transpose(counts))
counts_filtered <- counts[filter,]

library(reticulate)
use_virtualenv("../.venv/", required = TRUE)

# Ensure our local `python` folder (with `transformers.py`) is on sys.path
py_run_string("
import sys, os
local_python = os.path.abspath('../python')
if local_python not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, local_python)
")

# Load full fitted pipeline (joblib). Steps: DESeq2 norm -> MVG selection -> scaling.
py_run_string("import joblib")
py_run_string("pipeline = joblib.load('../data/out/final_models/pipelines/pipeline_ngenes_500.pkl')")
pipeline_2000 <- py$pipeline

# Get full gene name vector (for all genes)
counts_gene_names <- data.table::fread("../data/counts_20aug25.csv", select = 1, header = TRUE)[[1]]

# Build matrix of filtered counts (samples x all genes)
X_counts <- as.matrix(counts_filtered)
mode(X_counts) <- "numeric"
py$X <- X_counts

# DESeq2-only normalisation on ALL genes (no MVG filter, no scaler)
counts_deseq2_all <- py_to_r(pipeline_2000$named_steps$DEseq2$transform(py$X))
rownames(counts_deseq2_all) <- rownames(counts_filtered)
colnames(counts_deseq2_all) <- counts_gene_names
```

## Eta-squared: study vs subtype association per gene

```{r}
# Vectorized eta-squared (proportion of variance explained) per gene for study and subtype.
X <- as.matrix(counts_deseq2_all)
n <- nrow(X)
mean_g <- colMeans(X)
SS_total <- colSums((X - rep(mean_g, each = n))^2)
SS_total[SS_total <= 0] <- NA

study_f <- factor(filtered_study_names)
rs_study <- rowsum(X, study_f)
n_study <- as.vector(table(study_f))
mean_by_study <- rs_study / n_study
SS_between_study <- colSums(n_study * (mean_by_study - rep(mean_g, each = nrow(mean_by_study)))^2)
eta2_study <- SS_between_study / SS_total

subtype_f <- factor((filtered_leukemia_subtypes))
rs_subtype <- rowsum(X, subtype_f)
n_subtype <- as.vector(table(subtype_f))
mean_by_subtype <- rs_subtype / n_subtype
SS_between_subtype <- colSums(n_subtype * (mean_by_subtype - rep(mean_g, each = nrow(mean_by_subtype)))^2)
eta2_subtype <- SS_between_subtype / SS_total

eta2_study[is.nan(eta2_study)] <- NA
eta2_subtype[is.nan(eta2_subtype)] <- NA

df_eta2 <- data.frame(
  gene = counts_gene_names,
  eta2_study = as.numeric(eta2_study),
  eta2_subtype = as.numeric(eta2_subtype),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)


df_eta2$score_subtype_vs_study <- df_eta2$eta2_subtype - df_eta2$eta2_study
idx_ord <- order(df_eta2$score_subtype_vs_study, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)
df_eta2$rank_subtype <- match(seq_len(nrow(df_eta2)), idx_ord)  # rank by score_subtype_vs_study (1 = highest)
df_eta2$tier <- factor(
  ifelse(df_eta2$rank_subtype <= 250, "Top 250",
    ifelse(df_eta2$rank_subtype <= 500, "Top 500",
      ifelse(df_eta2$rank_subtype <= 1000, "Top 1000", "Other"))),
  levels = c("Top 250", "Top 500", "Top 1000", "Other")
)
genes_500_subtype <- df_eta2$gene[idx_ord[1:500]]
col_idx_500 <- match(genes_500_subtype, counts_gene_names)

tier_colors <- c("Top 1000" = "#d62728", "Top 500" = "#ff7f0e", "Top 250" = "#1f77b4", "Other" = "gray70")
p_eta2_2 <- ggplot(df_eta2, aes(x = eta2_study, y = eta2_subtype, color = tier)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(df_eta2, tier != "Other"), alpha = 0.7, size = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = subset(df_eta2, tier == "Other"), alpha = 0.35, size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_colors, name = "Rank") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = expression(eta^2 ~ "(study | gene expression)"),
    y = expression(eta^2 ~ "(subtype | gene expression)"),
    title = "Variance explained by study vs subtype, per gene"
  )
p_eta2_2
```

## t-SNE on 500 subtype-informative, study-invariant genes

```{r}
library(Rtsne)

# Rank genes by high eta2_subtype and low eta2_study (subtype signal, minimal batch)
df_eta2$score_subtype_vs_study <- df_eta2$eta2_subtype - df_eta2$eta2_study
idx_500 <- order(df_eta2$score_subtype_vs_study, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)[1:500]
genes_500_subtype <- df_eta2$gene[idx_500]
col_idx_500 <- match(genes_500_subtype, counts_gene_names)

# Expression for these 500 genes only
X_500 <- scale(counts_deseq2_all[, col_idx_500])
set.seed(42)

  X_500,

)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(stringr)

# helper: wrap legend labels in all discrete scales
wrap_legend_labels <- function(p, width = 16) {
  p + scale_color_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = width))
  # if you use fill/shape/etc, do similarly:
  # + scale_fill_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = width))
}

# helper: keep panel size fixed, legend in a separate fixed-height strip
make_cell <- function(p, label = NULL, legend_height = 0.28) {
  p_leg <- p + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  leg <- get_legend(p_leg)

  p_noleg <- p +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p_labeled <- if (is.null(label)) p_noleg else
    ggdraw(p_noleg) + draw_plot_label(label, x = 0.02, y = 0.98, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)

  plot_grid(
    p_labeled,
    leg,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, legend_height)  # same for all cells -> equal panel sizes
  )
}

# apply label wrapping where needed
p3w <- wrap_legend_labels(p_tsne_500_MDS, width = 14)
p4w <- wrap_legend_labels(p_tsne_500_KMT2A, width = 14)
p5w <- wrap_legend_labels(p_tsne_500_rare, width = 14)

# top row (as before)
top <- plot_grid(
  p_eta2_2 + theme(legend.position = "right"),
  p_tsne_500 + theme(legend.position = "right"),
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  ncol = 2,
  align = "h"
)

# bottom row: each cell has same panel area + controlled legend area
c_cell <- make_cell(p3w, "C", legend_height = 0.32)
d_cell <- make_cell(p4w, "D", legend_height = 0.32)
e_cell <- make_cell(p5w, "E", legend_height = 0.32)

bottom <- plot_grid(c_cell, d_cell, e_cell, ncol = 3, align = "h")

final <- plot_grid(top, bottom, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1.15))
final
```

# Ensemble Weights Analysis

##  --CV Weights Visualization

```{r}
# Helper: load global weights and build long df for plotting
prep_weights_long <- function(csv_path) {
  df <- read.csv(csv_path)
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(fold, svm_weight, xgb_weight, nn_weight) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(svm_weight, xgb_weight, nn_weight),
      names_to = "model",
      values_to = "weight"
    )
}

tidy_model_names <- function(df_long) {
  df_long$model <- gsub("_weight", "", df_long$model)
  df_long$model <- gsub("xgb", "XGBoost", df_long$model, ignore.case = TRUE)
  df_long$model <- gsub("svm", "SVM", df_long$model, ignore.case = TRUE)
  df_long$model <- gsub("nn", "DNN", df_long$model, ignore.case = TRUE)
  df_long$fold <- factor(paste0("Fold ", df_long$fold))
  df_long$weight <- as.numeric(df_long$weight)
  df_long
}

# Merged (global ensemble: merged/summed class probabilities)
df_merged <- prep_weights_long("../data/out/inner_cv/ensemble_weights_merged_summed_eta2/cv/global_ensemble_weights_used.csv")
df_merged <- tidy_model_names(df_merged)

p_weights_cv_merged <- ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = model, y = weight)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = fold), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "CV: Global ensemble weights (merged)",
    x = "Model",
    y = "Weight",
    color = "Fold"
  ) +
  ylim(-.01, 1)

p_weights_cv_merged
ggsave('../writing/figures_new/weights_per_fold_cv_merged.png', p_weights_cv_merged, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

##  --Combined: model selection trend across all four

```{r}
# Stack all four with a scenario label to compare weight trends

df_unmerged$scenario <- "CV (full)"
df_loso_merged$scenario <- "LOSO (collapsed)"
df_loso_unmerged$scenario <- "LOSO (full)"

df_weights_all <- rbind(df_merged, df_unmerged, df_loso_merged, df_loso_unmerged)
df_weights_all$scenario <- factor(df_weights_all$scenario,
  levels = c("CV (collapsed)", "CV (full)", "LOSO (collapsed)", "LOSO (full)"))
```

### Multivariate Platt Foldwise Diagnostics

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Evaluate fold-wise multivariate calibration behavior using the same leave-one-fold-out
# pool design used in the outer-CV script.
extract_mv_features <- function(prob_matrix) {
  meta_cols <- c(
    "y", "inner_fold", "outer_fold", "indices", "study", "sample_indices",
    "confidence_calibrated", "confidence_multivariate", "is_leftout",
    "n_models_agree", "mean_js_convergence", "top1_prob_variance_across_models"
  )
  prob_cols <- colnames(prob_matrix)[!colnames(prob_matrix) %in% meta_cols]
  if (length(prob_cols) == 0) return(data.frame())

  prob_mat <- as.matrix(prob_matrix[, prob_cols, drop = FALSE])
  n <- nrow(prob_mat)
  if (n == 0) return(data.frame())

  pred_idx <- max.col(prob_mat, ties.method = "first")
  max_prob <- prob_mat[cbind(seq_len(n), pred_idx)]

  prob_mat_mod <- prob_mat
  prob_mat_mod[cbind(seq_len(n), pred_idx)] <- -Inf
  second_prob <- prob_mat_mod[cbind(seq_len(n), max.col(prob_mat_mod, ties.method = "first"))]
  margin <- max_prob - second_prob

  pred <- gsub("Class\\. ", "", prob_cols[pred_idx])
  truth <- gsub("Class\\. ", "", prob_matrix$y)

  out <- data.frame(
    max_prob = as.numeric(max_prob),
    margin = as.numeric(margin),
    entropy = {
      prob_clipped <- pmax(prob_mat, 1e-12)
      if (ncol(prob_clipped) > 1) {
        ent <- -rowSums(prob_clipped * log(prob_clipped)) / log(ncol(prob_clipped))
        pmin(1, pmax(0, ent))
      } else {
        rep(0, n)
      }
    },
    n_models_agree = if ("n_models_agree" %in% colnames(prob_matrix)) as.numeric(prob_matrix$n_models_agree) else NA_real_,
    top1_prob_variance_across_models = if ("top1_prob_variance_across_models" %in% colnames(prob_matrix)) as.numeric(prob_matrix$top1_prob_variance_across_models) else NA_real_,
    correct = as.integer(truth == pred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out
}

calc_ece <- function(y_true, p_hat, n_bins = 10) {
  keep <- is.finite(y_true) & is.finite(p_hat)
  if (!any(keep)) return(NA_real_)
  y_true <- y_true[keep]
  p_hat <- p_hat[keep]
  bins <- cut(p_hat, breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  bin_tbl <- data.frame(y_true = y_true, p_hat = p_hat, bin = bins) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      obs = mean(y_true),
      conf = mean(p_hat),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  if (nrow(bin_tbl) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum((bin_tbl$n / sum(bin_tbl$n)) * abs(bin_tbl$obs - bin_tbl$conf))
}

calc_fold_metrics <- function(y_true, p_hat) {
  eps <- 1e-6
  p <- pmin(1 - eps, pmax(eps, p_hat))
  brier <- mean((y_true - p)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ece <- calc_ece(y_true, p, n_bins = 10)
  logit_p <- qlogis(p)
  slope_fit <- tryCatch(stats::glm(y_true ~ logit_p, family = stats::binomial), error = function(e) NULL)
  slope <- if (!is.null(slope_fit)) as.numeric(stats::coef(slope_fit)[["logit_p"]]) else NA_real_
  intercept <- if (!is.null(slope_fit)) as.numeric(stats::coef(slope_fit)[["(Intercept)"]]) else NA_real_
  data.frame(brier = brier, ece = ece, calib_slope = slope, calib_intercept = intercept, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

safe_mcfadden_r2 <- function(fit_obj) {
  if (is.null(fit_obj)) return(NA_real_)
  ll_fit <- tryCatch(as.numeric(stats::logLik(fit_obj)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  ll_null <- tryCatch(as.numeric(stats::logLik(update(fit_obj, . ~ 1))), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (!is.finite(ll_fit) || !is.finite(ll_null) || ll_null == 0) return(NA_real_)
  1 - (ll_fit / ll_null)
}

run_mv_foldwise_diagnostics <- function(res_obj, scenario_name = "merged") {
  all_rows <- list()
  all_coefs <- list()
  row_idx <- 1L
  coef_idx <- 1L

  for (regime in c("standard", "with_leftout")) {
    for (split_type in c("cv", "loso")) {
      mv_node <- res_obj$multivariate_results[[regime]][[split_type]]
      if (is.null(mv_node) || is.null(mv_node$fold_matrices)) next
      fold_mats <- mv_node$fold_matrices
      if (!is.list(fold_mats) || length(fold_mats) < 2L) next

      fold_names <- names(fold_mats)
      for (fold in fold_names) {
        target <- fold_mats[[fold]]
        others <- fold_mats[setdiff(fold_names, fold)]
        others_known <- lapply(others, function(m) {
          if ("is_leftout" %in% colnames(m)) m[!m$is_leftout, , drop = FALSE] else m
        })

        pool_df <- bind_rows(lapply(others_known, extract_mv_features))
        target_df <- extract_mv_features(target)
        if (nrow(pool_df) < 10 || nrow(target_df) == 0 || length(unique(pool_df$correct)) < 2) next

        candidate_terms <- c("max_prob", "margin", "entropy", "n_models_agree", "top1_prob_variance_across_models")
        usable_terms <- candidate_terms[sapply(candidate_terms, function(v) {
          v %in% colnames(pool_df) && any(is.finite(pool_df[[v]]))
        })]
        full_formula <- stats::as.formula(paste("correct ~", paste(usable_terms, collapse = " + ")))

        fit_full <- tryCatch(stats::glm(full_formula, data = pool_df, family = stats::binomial), error = function(e) NULL)
        fit_base <- tryCatch(stats::glm(correct ~ max_prob, data = pool_df, family = stats::binomial), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit_base)) next
        if (is.null(fit_full)) fit_full <- fit_base

        p_full <- tryCatch(as.numeric(stats::predict(fit_full, newdata = target_df, type = "response")), error = function(e) NULL)
        p_base <- tryCatch(as.numeric(stats::predict(fit_base, newdata = target_df, type = "response")), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(p_full) || is.null(p_base)) next

        m_full <- calc_fold_metrics(target_df$correct, p_full)
        m_base <- calc_fold_metrics(target_df$correct, p_base)

        all_rows[[row_idx]] <- data.frame(
          scenario = scenario_name,
          regime = regime,
          split_type = split_type,
          fold = fold,
          n_pool = nrow(pool_df),
          n_target = nrow(target_df),
          full_formula = paste(deparse(stats::formula(fit_full)), collapse = ""),
          aic_full = stats::AIC(fit_full),
          aic_base = stats::AIC(fit_base),
          aic_delta_base_minus_full = stats::AIC(fit_base) - stats::AIC(fit_full),
          mcfadden_r2_full = safe_mcfadden_r2(fit_full),
          mcfadden_r2_base = safe_mcfadden_r2(fit_base),
          brier_full = m_full$brier,
          brier_base = m_base$brier,
          brier_delta_base_minus_full = m_base$brier - m_full$brier,
          ece_full = m_full$ece,
          ece_base = m_base$ece,
          ece_delta_base_minus_full = m_base$ece - m_full$ece,
          calib_slope_full = m_full$calib_slope,
          calib_intercept_full = m_full$calib_intercept,
          calib_slope_base = m_base$calib_slope,
          calib_intercept_base = m_base$calib_intercept,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        row_idx <- row_idx + 1L

        coef_mat <- summary(fit_full)$coefficients
        coef_df <- data.frame(
          scenario = scenario_name,
          regime = regime,
          split_type = split_type,
          fold = fold,
          term = rownames(coef_mat),
          estimate = as.numeric(coef_mat[, "Estimate"]),
          std_error = as.numeric(coef_mat[, "Std. Error"]),
          z_value = as.numeric(coef_mat[, "z value"]),
          p_value = as.numeric(coef_mat[, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        all_coefs[[coef_idx]] <- coef_df
        coef_idx <- coef_idx + 1L
      }
    }
  }

  fold_metrics <- bind_rows(all_rows)
  coef_table <- bind_rows(all_coefs)
  coef_stability <- coef_table %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    group_by(scenario, regime, split_type, term) %>%
    summarise(
      n_folds = n(),
      mean_estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_estimate = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
      positive_rate = mean(estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_lt_0_05_rate = mean(p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(scenario, regime, split_type, desc(abs(mean_estimate)))

  list(
    fold_metrics = fold_metrics,
    coef_table = coef_table,
    coef_stability = coef_stability
  )
}

mv_diag_merged <- run_mv_foldwise_diagnostics(outer_merged, "merged")
mv_diag_unmerged <- run_mv_foldwise_diagnostics(outer_unmerged, "unmerged")

mv_diag_fold_metrics <- bind_rows(mv_diag_merged$fold_metrics, mv_diag_unmerged$fold_metrics)
mv_diag_coef_table <- bind_rows(mv_diag_merged$coef_table, mv_diag_unmerged$coef_table)
mv_diag_coef_stability <- bind_rows(mv_diag_merged$coef_stability, mv_diag_unmerged$coef_stability)

# Compact across-fold summary for quick reading.

  group_by(scenario, regime, split_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_folds = n(),
    mean_aic_delta = mean(aic_delta_base_minus_full, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_brier_delta = mean(brier_delta_base_minus_full, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ece_delta = mean(ece_delta_base_minus_full, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_calib_slope_full = mean(calib_slope_full, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_calib_slope_base = mean(calib_slope_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario, regime, split_type)

mv_diag_out_dir <- file.path("../data/out/outer_cv", "multivariate_platt_diagnostics")
dir.create(mv_diag_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(mv_diag_fold_metrics, file.path(mv_diag_out_dir, "fold_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(mv_diag_coef_table, file.path(mv_diag_out_dir, "coefficients_by_fold.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Final verdict table:
# 1) model-level winner (multivariate vs simple)
# 2) term-level usefulness call based on fold stability/significance
model_verdict <- mv_diag_summary %>%
  mutate(
    # Positive deltas favor multivariate (full model).
    support_score = as.integer(mean_aic_delta > 2) +
      as.integer(mean_brier_delta > 0) +
      as.integer(mean_ece_delta > 0),
    verdict = dplyr::case_when(
      support_score >= 2 ~ "multivariate_better",
      support_score == 1 ~ "tie_or_context_dependent",
      TRUE ~ "simple_better"
    ),
    slope_winner = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(mean_calib_slope_full) & is.finite(mean_calib_slope_base) &
        abs(mean_calib_slope_full - 1) < abs(mean_calib_slope_base - 1) ~ "multivariate",
      is.finite(mean_calib_slope_full) & is.finite(mean_calib_slope_base) &
        abs(mean_calib_slope_full - 1) > abs(mean_calib_slope_base - 1) ~ "simple",
      TRUE ~ "undetermined"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario, regime, split_type)

term_verdict <- mv_diag_coef_stability %>%
  mutate(
    sign_stable = (positive_rate >= 0.8) | (positive_rate <= 0.2),
    significant_often = p_lt_0_05_rate >= 0.5,
    effect_stability = dplyr::if_else(abs(mean_estimate) > sd_estimate, "stable", "noisy"),
    term_usefulness = dplyr::case_when(
      sign_stable & significant_often & effect_stability == "stable" ~ "likely_useful",
      sign_stable & (significant_often | effect_stability == "stable") ~ "possibly_useful",
      TRUE ~ "weak_or_inconsistent"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario, regime, split_type, desc(term_usefulness), term)

# Optional rollup: keep only terms from groups where multivariate is favored.
term_verdict_in_winning_groups <- term_verdict %>%
  inner_join(
    model_verdict %>%
      filter(verdict == "multivariate_better") %>%
      select(scenario, regime, split_type),
    by = c("scenario", "regime", "split_type")
  )

write.csv(model_verdict, file.path(mv_diag_out_dir, "final_model_verdict.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(term_verdict, file.path(mv_diag_out_dir, "final_term_verdict.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  term_verdict_in_winning_groups,
  file.path(mv_diag_out_dir, "final_term_verdict_multivariate_wins_only.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

model_verdict
term_verdict %>% select(regime, term, term_usefulness, split_type) %>% group_by(term, split_type) %>% summarise(sum(term_usefulness != "weak_or_inconsistent"))
```
