```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Global Ensemble-only risk-coverage analysis:
# - method: simple Platt vs multivariate
# - regime: test_only vs with_leftout
# - split: cv vs loso

outer_cv_root <- "../data/out/outer_cv/outer_cv_analysis_outputs_merged_summed"
selection_out_dir <- file.path(outer_cv_root, "global_ensemble_selection")
dir.create(selection_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

scenario_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~method,         ~regime,        ~subdir,                               ~model_label,
  "platt_simple",  "test_only",    "standard",                            "Global_Optimized",
  "platt_simple",  "with_leftout", "with_leftout",                        "Global_Optimized",
  "multivariate",  "test_only",    "ensemble_multivariate/standard",      "Global_Optimized_MV",
  "multivariate",  "with_leftout", "ensemble_multivariate/with_leftout",  "Global_Optimized_MV_leftout"
)

read_curve <- function(base_dir, split_type, curve_source = c("heldout", "trainpool")) {
  curve_source <- match.arg(curve_source)
  file_name <- if (curve_source == "heldout") {
    paste0("risk_coverage_heldout_curve_raw_", split_type, ".csv")
  } else {
    paste0("risk_coverage_trainpool_curve_", split_type, ".csv")
  }
  path <- file.path(base_dir, file_name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

normalize_curve_schema <- function(df, curve_source, method, regime, split_type, model_label) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (curve_source == "heldout") {
    out <- df %>%
      filter(model == model_label) %>%
      transmute(
        method = method,
        regime = regime,
        split_type = split_type,
        curve_source = "heldout",
        fold = as.character(fold),
        prob_cutoff = prob_cutoff,
        risk = 1 - accuracy,
        coverage = 1 - perc_rejected,
        model = model
      )
  } else {
    out <- df %>%
      filter(model == model_label) %>%
      transmute(
        method = method,
        regime = regime,
        split_type = split_type,
        curve_source = "trainpool",
        fold = as.character(held_out_fold),
        prob_cutoff = prob_cutoff,
        risk = train_risk,
        coverage = train_coverage,
        model = model
      )
  }
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  out
}

build_monotonic_frontier <- function(curve_df) {
  curve_df %>%
    group_by(method, regime, split_type, curve_source, prob_cutoff) %>%
    summarise(
      risk = mean(risk, na.rm = TRUE),
      coverage = mean(coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
      # sd() is NA for a single observation; use 0 so SE/ribbon summaries stay defined.
      risk_sd = ifelse(dplyr::n() > 1, sd(risk, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      coverage_sd = ifelse(dplyr::n() > 1, sd(coverage, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      n_folds = n_distinct(fold),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(method, regime, split_type, curve_source, risk, desc(coverage)) %>%
    group_by(method, regime, split_type, curve_source) %>%
    mutate(coverage_mono = cummax(coverage)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

pick_cutoff_grid <- function(frontier_df, target_risks = c(0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10)) {
  out <- list()
  idx <- 1L
  groups <- frontier_df %>% distinct(method, regime, split_type, curve_source)
  for (g in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
    grp <- groups[g, ]
    df <- frontier_df %>%
      filter(
        method == grp$method,
        regime == grp$regime,
        split_type == grp$split_type,
        curve_source == grp$curve_source
      )
    for (tr in target_risks) {
      eligible <- df %>% filter(risk <= tr)
      chosen <- if (nrow(eligible) > 0) {
        eligible %>% arrange(desc(coverage_mono), risk, coverage_sd) %>% slice(1)
      } else {
        df %>% arrange(risk, desc(coverage_mono), coverage_sd) %>% slice(1)
      }
      out[[idx]] <- chosen %>%
        mutate(
          target_risk = tr,
          risk_status = ifelse(chosen$risk <= tr, "within_target", "min_risk_fallback")
        )
      idx <- idx + 1L
    }
  }
  bind_rows(out) %>%
    select(method, regime, split_type, curve_source, target_risk, risk_status,
           prob_cutoff, risk, coverage, coverage_mono, risk_sd, coverage_sd, n_folds)
}
```

```{r}
# Load all scenarios into one long table.
curve_rows <- list()
idx <- 1L
for (i in seq_len(nrow(scenario_map))) {
  sc <- scenario_map[i, ]
  base_dir <- file.path(outer_cv_root, sc$subdir)
  for (split_type in c("cv", "loso")) {
    for (curve_source in c("heldout", "trainpool")) {
      raw <- read_curve(base_dir, split_type, curve_source)
      norm <- normalize_curve_schema(raw, curve_source, sc$method, sc$regime, split_type, sc$model_label)
      if (!is.null(norm) && nrow(norm) > 0) {
        curve_rows[[idx]] <- norm
        idx <- idx + 1L
```

```{r}
# Foldwise sanity-check:
# pick cutoff from pooled trainpool curves (excluding test fold), evaluate on heldout test fold.
trainpool_curve <- all_curves %>%
  filter(method == "multivariate", regime == "with_leftout", curve_source == "trainpool", split_type == "cv")
heldout_curve <- all_curves %>%
  filter(method == "multivariate", regime == "with_leftout", curve_source == "heldout", split_type == "cv")

res_list <- list()
for (test in unique(heldout_curve$fold)) {
  # Use the trainpool curve that is explicitly built for this held-out fold.
  train_curves <- trainpool_curve %>% filter(fold == test)
  test_curve <- heldout_curve %>% filter(fold == test)

  best <- train_curves %>%
    group_by(prob_cutoff) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_coverage = mean(coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_risk = mean(risk, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(mean_risk <= 0.06) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_coverage), mean_risk) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  if (nrow(best) == 0) {
    best <- train_curves %>%
      group_by(prob_cutoff) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_coverage = mean(coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_risk = mean(risk, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(mean_risk, desc(mean_coverage)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)
  }

  res <- test_curve %>%
    filter(prob_cutoff == best$prob_cutoff) %>%
    transmute(fold = test, risk, coverage, prob_cutoff)
  res_list[[test]] <- res
}

do.call(rbind, res_list)
do.call(rbind, res_list) %>% summarise(mean(risk), sd(risk), mean(coverage), sd(coverage))
```

```{r}
# Selected monotonic operating points from dense target-risk grids for CV and LOSO.
build_selected_points <- function(split_name, target_risk_grid = seq(0.001, 0.12, by = 0.0005)) {
  selected <- lapply(unique(frontiers$regime), function(reg_i) {
    df <- frontiers %>%
      filter(
        curve_source == "trainpool",
        method == "multivariate",
        split_type == split_name,
        regime == reg_i
      )
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(target_risk_grid, function(tr) {
      eligible <- df %>% filter(risk <= tr)
      chosen <- if (nrow(eligible) > 0) {
        eligible %>% arrange(desc(coverage_mono), risk, coverage_sd) %>% slice(1)
      } else {
        df %>% arrange(risk, desc(coverage_mono), coverage_sd) %>% slice(1)
      }
      chosen %>%
        mutate(
          target_risk = tr,
          risk_status = ifelse(risk <= tr, "within_target", "min_risk_fallback"),
          train_risk = risk,
          train_coverage_mono = coverage_mono
        )
    }))
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    select(method, regime, split_type, target_risk, risk_status, prob_cutoff, train_risk, train_coverage_mono) %>%
    left_join(
      frontiers %>%
        filter(curve_source == "heldout", method == "multivariate", split_type == split_name) %>%
        select(method, regime, split_type, prob_cutoff, heldout_risk = risk, heldout_coverage = coverage),
      by = c("method", "regime", "split_type", "prob_cutoff")
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(train_risk), is.finite(heldout_risk), is.finite(heldout_coverage), risk_status == "within_target", train_coverage_mono != 1)

  selected
}

}
```

```{r}
map_truth_to_canonical <- function(truth_labels) {
  mapping <- c(
    "AML-MR_cyto" = "AML with MDS-related cytogenetic abnormalities",
    "AML-MR_mut" = "AML with MDS-related gene mutations",
    "AML-CEBPA" = "AML with in-frame bZIP CEBPA",
    "AML-CBFB::MYH11" = "AML with inv(16)/t(16;16)/CBFB::MYH11",
    "AML-NPM1" = "AML with mutated NPM1",
    "AML-TP53" = "AML with mutated TP53",
    "AML-DEK::NUP214" = "AML with t(6;9)/DEK::NUP214",
    "AML-RUNX1::RUNX1T1" = "AML with t(8;21)/RUNX1::RUNX1T1",
    "AML-KMT2A::MLLT3" = "AML with t(9;11)/MLLT3::KMT2A",
    "APL-PML::RARA" = "APL, t(15;17)/PML::RARA",
    "AML-GATA2::MECOM" = "GATA2;MECOM",
    "AML-otherMECOM" = "MECOM, other"
  )
  
  sapply(truth_labels, function(x) {
    if (x %in% names(mapping)) {
      return(mapping[x])
    } else {
      return(x)  # Return NA for unmapped labels
    }
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

# Survival

## -- Survival: Main cohort (outer CV test set)

## -- Survival: Wrong predictions vs true label

Compare survival of misclassified samples (wrongly predicted as label L) to survival of samples that truly have label L. Done separately per predicted label L where both groups have enough events.

```{r survival_wrong_predictions}
library(survival)

# Restrict to samples with non-NA survival and event
surv_ok <- !is.na(sample_level_df$survival_days) & !is.na(sample_level_df$event)
df_surv <- sample_level_df[surv_ok, ]

wrong_by_pred <- split(
  df_surv[!df_surv$correct, ],
  df_surv$prediction_display[!df_surv$correct]
)
true_by_label <- split(df_surv, df_surv$truth_display)

# For each predicted label L: compare (wrongly predicted as L) vs (truly L)
survival_wrong_vs_true <- list()
for (L in names(wrong_by_pred)) {
  wrong_L <- wrong_by_pred[[L]]
  true_L <- true_by_label[[L]]
  if (is.null(true_L)) next
  n_wrong <- nrow(wrong_L)
  n_true <- nrow(true_L)
  if (n_wrong < 1 || n_true < 1) next

  dat <- rbind(
    data.frame(survival_days = wrong_L$survival_days, event = wrong_L$event, group = "Wrongly predicted as"),
    data.frame(survival_days = true_L$survival_days, event = true_L$event, group = "Truly")
  )
  dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = c("Wrongly predicted as", "Truly"))
  s <- survdiff(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group, data = dat)
  survival_wrong_vs_true[[L]] <- list(
    n_wrong = n_wrong, n_true = n_true,
    median_wrong = median(wrong_L$survival_days), median_true = median(true_L$survival_days),
    chisq = s$chisq, pval = 1 - pchisq(s$chisq, 1)
  )
}

survival_wrong_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(survival_wrong_vs_true), function(L) {
  x <- survival_wrong_vs_true[[L]]
  if (x$n_wrong < 10) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    predicted_label = L,
    n_wrongly_predicted = x$n_wrong, n_truly = x$n_true,
    median_survival_days_wrong = x$median_wrong, median_survival_days_true = x$median_true,
    logrank_chisq = x$chisq, logrank_p = x$pval
  )
}))
rownames(survival_wrong_summary) <- NULL
survival_wrong_summary
```

## -- Survival: AML NOS predicted as class L vs truly L

AML NOS samples were left out and predicted to a class (e.g. CEBPA). For each predicted class L, compare survival of (AML NOS predicted as L) to survival of samples that truly have class L (main cohort).

```{r survival_AML_NOS}
# Left-out AML NOS samples with valid survival; align prediction to display names
nos_only <- leftout_df[leftout_df$NOS & !is.na(leftout_df$survival_days) & !is.na(leftout_df$event), ]
nos_only$prediction_display <- fix_names(modify_classes(nos_only$prediction))

# Truly L: from main cohort (sample_level_df) with valid survival
surv_ok <- !is.na(sample_level_df$survival_days) & !is.na(sample_level_df$event)
true_by_label <- split(sample_level_df[surv_ok, ], sample_level_df$truth_display[surv_ok])

# Align leftout prediction names to canonical truth_display names (same as names(true_by_label))
pred_to_canonical <- c("AML.with.in-frame.bZIP.CEBPA" = "CEBPA bZIP in-frame")
nos_only$prediction_canonical <- ifelse(
  nos_only$prediction_display %in% names(pred_to_canonical),
  pred_to_canonical[nos_only$prediction_display],
  nos_only$prediction_display
)

# For each predicted label L among AML NOS: compare (NOS predicted as L) vs (truly L)
survival_nos_vs_true <- list()
for (L in unique(nos_only$prediction_canonical)) {
  nos_pred_L <- nos_only[nos_only$prediction_canonical == L, ]
  true_L <- true_by_label[[L]]
  if (is.null(true_L) || nrow(nos_pred_L) < 1 || nrow(true_L) < 1) next

  dat <- rbind(
    data.frame(survival_days = nos_pred_L$survival_days, event = nos_pred_L$event, group = "AML NOS predicted as"),
    data.frame(survival_days = true_L$survival_days, event = true_L$event, group = "Truly")
  )
  dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = c("AML NOS predicted as", "Truly"))
  s <- survdiff(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group, data = dat)
  survival_nos_vs_true[[L]] <- list(
    n_nos_predicted_as_L = nrow(nos_pred_L), n_truly_L = nrow(true_L),
    median_nos = median(nos_pred_L$survival_days), median_true = median(true_L$survival_days),
    chisq = s$chisq, pval = 1 - pchisq(s$chisq, 1)
  )
}

survival_nos_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(survival_nos_vs_true), function(L) {
  x <- survival_nos_vs_true[[L]]
  if (x$n_nos_predicted_as_L < 10) return(NULL)

  data.frame(
    predicted_class = L,
    n_AML_NOS_predicted_as = x$n_nos_predicted_as_L, n_truly = x$n_truly_L,
    median_survival_days_NOS_pred = x$median_nos, median_survival_days_true = x$median_true,
    logrank_chisq = x$chisq, logrank_p = x$pval
  )
}))
rownames(survival_nos_summary) <- NULL
survival_nos_summary
```

## -- Survival: Multi predicted as class L vs truly L

Multi-lineage samples were left out and predicted to a class. For each predicted class L, compare survival of (Multi predicted as L) to survival of samples that truly have class L (main cohort).

```{r survival_Multi}
# Left-out Multi samples with valid survival; align prediction to display names
multi_only <- leftout_df[leftout_df$multi & !is.na(leftout_df$survival_days) & !is.na(leftout_df$event), ]
multi_only$prediction_display <- fix_names(modify_classes(multi_only$prediction))

# Truly L: from main cohort (sample_level_df) with valid survival
surv_ok_multi <- !is.na(sample_level_df$survival_days) & !is.na(sample_level_df$event)
true_by_label_multi <- split(sample_level_df[surv_ok_multi, ], sample_level_df$truth_display[surv_ok_multi])

# Align leftout prediction names to canonical truth_display names
multi_only$prediction_canonical <- ifelse(
  multi_only$prediction_display %in% names(pred_to_canonical),
  pred_to_canonical[multi_only$prediction_display],
  multi_only$prediction_display
)

# For each predicted label L among Multi: compare (Multi predicted as L) vs (truly L)
survival_multi_vs_true <- list()
for (L in unique(multi_only$prediction_canonical)) {
  multi_pred_L <- multi_only[multi_only$prediction_canonical == L, ]
  true_L <- true_by_label_multi[[L]]
  if (is.null(true_L) || nrow(multi_pred_L) < 1 || nrow(true_L) < 1) next

  dat <- rbind(
    data.frame(survival_days = multi_pred_L$survival_days, event = multi_pred_L$event, group = "Multi predicted as"),
    data.frame(survival_days = true_L$survival_days, event = true_L$event, group = "Truly")
  )
  dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = c("Multi predicted as", "Truly"))
  s <- survdiff(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group, data = dat)
  survival_multi_vs_true[[L]] <- list(
    n_multi_predicted_as_L = nrow(multi_pred_L), n_truly_L = nrow(true_L),
    median_multi = median(multi_pred_L$survival_days), median_true = median(true_L$survival_days),
    chisq = s$chisq, pval = 1 - pchisq(s$chisq, 1)
  )
}

survival_multi_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(survival_multi_vs_true), function(L) {
  x <- survival_multi_vs_true[[L]]
  if (x$n_multi_predicted_as_L < 10) return(NULL)

  data.frame(
    predicted_class = L,
    n_Multi_predicted_as = x$n_multi_predicted_as_L, n_truly = x$n_truly_L,
    median_survival_days_Multi_pred = x$median_multi, median_survival_days_true = x$median_true,
    logrank_chisq = x$chisq, logrank_p = x$pval
  )
}))
rownames(survival_multi_summary) <- NULL
survival_multi_summary
```

### Combined pooled analysis: Truly / Wrong / NOS / Multi (main cohort, 4 groups)

One stratified Cox and one KM with four groups per label L: Truly L, Wrongly predicted as L, NOS predicted as L, Multi predicted as L. Labels L are those with at least one of these groups and with a defined Truly L from the main cohort.

```{r survival_main_combined_pooled}
# Labels L that have Truly L and at least one of Wrong, NOS or Multi predicted as L
labels_main_combined <- unique(c(
  names(survival_wrong_vs_true),
  names(survival_nos_vs_true),
  names(survival_multi_vs_true)
))
labels_main_combined <- labels_main_combined[vapply(labels_main_combined, function(L) !is.null(true_by_label[[L]]), logical(1))]

pooled_main_four_list <- list()
for (L in labels_main_combined) {
  true_L <- true_by_label[[L]]
  wrong_L <- wrong_by_pred[[L]]
  nos_pred_L <- nos_only[nos_only$prediction_canonical == L, ]
  multi_pred_L <- multi_only[multi_only$prediction_canonical == L, ]
  if (is.null(true_L) || nrow(true_L) < 1) next

  parts <- list(
    data.frame(
      survival_days = true_L$survival_days,
      event = true_L$event,
      age_years = true_L$age_years,
      sex = true_L$sex,
      group = "Truly",
      label = L,
      cohort = true_L$cohort
    )
  )
  if (!is.null(wrong_L) && nrow(wrong_L) > 0) {
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = wrong_L$survival_days,
      event = wrong_L$event,
      age_years = wrong_L$age_years,
      sex = wrong_L$sex,
      group = "Wrongly predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = wrong_L$cohort
    )
  }
  if (nrow(nos_pred_L) > 0) {
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = nos_pred_L$survival_days,
      event = nos_pred_L$event,
      age_years = nos_pred_L$age_years,
      sex = nos_pred_L$sex,
      group = "NOS predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = nos_pred_L$cohort
    )
  }
  if (nrow(multi_pred_L) > 0) {
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = multi_pred_L$survival_days,
      event = multi_pred_L$event,
      age_years = multi_pred_L$age_years,
      sex = multi_pred_L$sex,
      group = "Multi predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = multi_pred_L$cohort
    )
  }
  pooled_main_four_list[[L]] <- do.call(rbind, parts)
}
pooled_main_four_df <- do.call(rbind, pooled_main_four_list)
pooled_main_four_df$group <- factor(pooled_main_four_df$group, levels = c("Truly", "Wrongly predicted as", "NOS predicted as", "Multi predicted as"))
pooled_main_four_df$cohort <- factor(pooled_main_four_df$cohort)

pooled_main_four_df$sex <- factor(pooled_main_four_df$sex)

cox_main_combined <- coxph(
  Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group + age_years + sex + cohort + strata(label),
  data = pooled_main_four_df
)
summary(cox_main_combined)
```

## -- MLL Lab: Survival (OS_days, Censor)

Build sample-level data for validation cohort with survival; use OS_days and Censor from MLL_lab.

```{r MLL_lab_survival_setup}
# Sample-level df for MLL Lab: truth, prediction, correct, survival (OS_days = time, Censor = event)
# Use canonical display names so labels match main cohort and combined analyses
MLL_lab_sample_df <- data.frame(
  truth_display = map_mll_to_display(MLL_lab_truth),
  prediction_display = map_mll_to_display(MLL_lab_predictions),
  survival_days = MLL_lab$OS_days,
  event = as.integer(MLL_lab$Censor),
  age_years = NA_real_,  # age not available in current MLL metadata
  sex = ifelse(
    tolower(MLL_lab$Gender) %in% c("female", "f"), "Female",
    ifelse(tolower(MLL_lab$Gender) %in% c("male", "m"), "Male", NA_character_)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
MLL_lab_sample_df$correct <- MLL_lab_sample_df$truth_display == MLL_lab_sample_df$prediction_display
```

## -- Survival: Wrong and NOS predictions vs true label (MLL Lab)

Compare survival of misclassified (wrong) and NOS-predicted samples to truly L. Uses OS_days and Censor. MLL_lab_sample_df uses canonical display names (e.g. "AML NOS").

```{r survival_MLL_wrong_predictions}
# Valid survival; non-NOS for "truly L" and wrong; NOS for "NOS predicted as L"
mll_surv_ok <- !is.na(MLL_lab_sample_df$survival_days) & !is.na(MLL_lab_sample_df$event)
mll_non_nos <- MLL_lab_sample_df$truth_display != "AML NOS"
mll_df_surv <- MLL_lab_sample_df[mll_surv_ok & mll_non_nos, ]

wrong_by_pred_mll <- split(
  mll_df_surv[!mll_df_surv$correct, ],
  mll_df_surv$prediction_display[!mll_df_surv$correct]
)
true_by_label_mll <- split(mll_df_surv, mll_df_surv$truth_display)

survival_mll_wrong_vs_true <- list()
for (L in names(wrong_by_pred_mll)) {
  wrong_L <- wrong_by_pred_mll[[L]]
  true_L <- true_by_label_mll[[L]]
  if (is.null(true_L)) next
  n_wrong <- nrow(wrong_L)
  n_true <- nrow(true_L)
  if (n_wrong < 1 || n_true < 1) next

  dat <- rbind(
    data.frame(survival_days = wrong_L$survival_days, event = wrong_L$event, group = "Wrongly predicted as"),
    data.frame(survival_days = true_L$survival_days, event = true_L$event, group = "Truly")
  )
  dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = c("Wrongly predicted as", "Truly"))
  s <- survdiff(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group, data = dat)
  survival_mll_wrong_vs_true[[L]] <- list(
    n_wrong = n_wrong, n_true = n_true,
    median_wrong = median(wrong_L$survival_days), median_true = median(true_L$survival_days),
    chisq = s$chisq, pval = 1 - pchisq(s$chisq, 1)
  )
}

survival_mll_wrong_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(survival_mll_wrong_vs_true), function(L) {
  x <- survival_mll_wrong_vs_true[[L]]
  if (x$n_wrong < 10) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    predicted_label = L,
    n_wrongly_predicted = x$n_wrong, n_truly = x$n_true,
    median_OS_days_wrong = x$median_wrong, median_OS_days_true = x$median_true,
    logrank_chisq = x$chisq, logrank_p = x$pval
  )
}))
rownames(survival_mll_wrong_summary) <- NULL
survival_mll_wrong_summary
```

## -- Survival: AML NOS predicted as class L vs truly L (MLL Lab)

```{r survival_MLL_NOS}
mll_nos_only <- MLL_lab_sample_df[MLL_lab_sample_df$truth_display == "AML NOS" & mll_surv_ok, ]
if (nrow(mll_nos_only) > 0) {
  # true_by_label_mll already has non-NOS samples with valid survival
  survival_mll_nos_vs_true <- list()
  for (L in unique(mll_nos_only$prediction_display)) {
    nos_pred_L <- mll_nos_only[mll_nos_only$prediction_display == L, ]
    true_L <- true_by_label_mll[[L]]
    if (is.null(true_L) || nrow(nos_pred_L) < 1 || nrow(true_L) < 1) next

    dat <- rbind(
      data.frame(survival_days = nos_pred_L$survival_days, event = nos_pred_L$event, group = "AML NOS predicted as"),
      data.frame(survival_days = true_L$survival_days, event = true_L$event, group = "Truly")
    )
    dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = c("AML NOS predicted as", "Truly"))
    s <- survdiff(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group, data = dat)
    survival_mll_nos_vs_true[[L]] <- list(
      n_nos_predicted_as_L = nrow(nos_pred_L), n_truly_L = nrow(true_L),
      median_nos = median(nos_pred_L$survival_days), median_true = median(true_L$survival_days),
      chisq = s$chisq, pval = 1 - pchisq(s$chisq, 1)
    )
  }

  survival_mll_nos_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(survival_mll_nos_vs_true), function(L) {
    x <- survival_mll_nos_vs_true[[L]]
    if (x$n_nos_predicted_as_L < 10) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      predicted_class = L,
      n_AML_NOS_predicted_as = x$n_nos_predicted_as_L, n_truly = x$n_truly_L,
      median_OS_days_NOS_pred = x$median_nos, median_OS_days_true = x$median_true,
      logrank_chisq = x$chisq, logrank_p = x$pval
    )
  }))
  rownames(survival_mll_nos_summary) <- NULL
  survival_mll_nos_summary
} else {
  message("No AML NOS samples with valid survival in MLL Lab cohort.")
  survival_mll_nos_summary <- data.frame()
  survival_mll_nos_vs_true <- list()
}
```

### Combined pooled analysis: Truly / Wrong / NOS (MLL Lab, 3 groups)

```{r survival_MLL_combined_pooled}
labels_mll_combined <- unique(c(names(survival_mll_wrong_vs_true), names(survival_mll_nos_vs_true)))
labels_mll_combined <- labels_mll_combined[vapply(labels_mll_combined, function(L) !is.null(true_by_label_mll[[L]]), logical(1))]

pooled_mll_three_list <- list()
for (L in labels_mll_combined) {
  true_L <- true_by_label_mll[[L]]
  wrong_L <- wrong_by_pred_mll[[L]]
  nos_pred_L <- mll_nos_only[mll_nos_only$prediction_display == L, ]
  if (is.null(true_L) || nrow(true_L) < 1) next

  parts <- list(
    data.frame(
      survival_days = true_L$survival_days,
      event = true_L$event,
      age_years = true_L$age_years,
      sex = true_L$sex,
      group = "Truly",
      label = L,
      cohort = "MLL"
    )
  )
  if (!is.null(wrong_L) && nrow(wrong_L) > 0)
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = wrong_L$survival_days,
      event = wrong_L$event,
      age_years = wrong_L$age_years,
      sex = wrong_L$sex,
      group = "Wrongly predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = "MLL"
    )
  if (nrow(nos_pred_L) > 0)
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = nos_pred_L$survival_days,
      event = nos_pred_L$event,
      age_years = nos_pred_L$age_years,
      sex = nos_pred_L$sex,
      group = "NOS predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = "MLL"
    )
  pooled_mll_three_list[[L]] <- do.call(rbind, parts)
}
pooled_mll_three_df <- do.call(rbind, pooled_mll_three_list)
if (nrow(pooled_mll_three_df) > 0) {
  pooled_mll_three_df$group <- factor(pooled_mll_three_df$group, levels = c("Truly", "Wrongly predicted as", "NOS predicted as"))
  pooled_mll_three_df$cohort <- factor(pooled_mll_three_df$cohort)
  pooled_mll_three_df$sex <- factor(pooled_mll_three_df$sex)
  cox_mll_combined <- coxph(
    Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group + sex + strata(label),
    data = pooled_mll_three_df
  )
  summary(cox_mll_combined)
}
```

## -- Combined survival: Outer CV + MLL Lab (boost n)

Pool outer-fold predictions (main cohort), MLL Lab validation cohort, and left-out AML NOS (main cohort) for survival analysis. Class names use main-cohort display names; MLL_lab_sample_df already uses map_mll_to_display.

```{r combined_survival_setup}
# Main cohort: samples with valid survival; cohort = study (BEAT, TARGET, etc.)
surv_ok_main <- !is.na(sample_level_df$survival_days) & !is.na(sample_level_df$event)
df_main <- data.frame(
  truth_display = sample_level_df$truth_display[surv_ok_main],
  prediction_display = sample_level_df$prediction_display[surv_ok_main],
  correct = sample_level_df$correct[surv_ok_main],
  survival_days = sample_level_df$survival_days[surv_ok_main],
  event = sample_level_df$event[surv_ok_main],
  cohort = sample_level_df$cohort[surv_ok_main],
  age_years = sample_level_df$age_years[surv_ok_main],
  sex = sample_level_df$sex[surv_ok_main],
  source = "outer_cv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# MLL Lab: valid survival (already canonical); cohort = MLL
mll_surv_ok_combined <- !is.na(MLL_lab_sample_df$survival_days) & !is.na(MLL_lab_sample_df$event)
df_mll <- data.frame(
  truth_display = MLL_lab_sample_df$truth_display[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  prediction_display = MLL_lab_sample_df$prediction_display[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  correct = MLL_lab_sample_df$correct[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  survival_days = MLL_lab_sample_df$survival_days[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  event = MLL_lab_sample_df$event[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  cohort = "MLL",
  age_years = MLL_lab_sample_df$age_years[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  sex = MLL_lab_sample_df$sex[mll_surv_ok_combined],
  source = "MLL_lab",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Left-out AML NOS (main cohort): cohort = study from leftout_df
df_leftout_nos <- data.frame(
  truth_display = "AML NOS",
  prediction_display = nos_only$prediction_canonical,
  correct = FALSE,
  survival_days = nos_only$survival_days,
  event = nos_only$event,
  cohort = nos_only$cohort,
  age_years = nos_only$age_years,
  sex = nos_only$sex,
  source = "leftout_NOS",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Left-out Multi (main cohort): cohort = study from leftout_df
df_leftout_multi <- data.frame(
  truth_display = "Multi",
  prediction_display = multi_only$prediction_canonical,
  correct = FALSE,
  survival_days = multi_only$survival_days,
  event = multi_only$event,
  cohort = multi_only$cohort,
  age_years = multi_only$age_years,
  sex = multi_only$sex,
  source = "leftout_Multi",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

combined_survival_df <- rbind(df_main, df_mll, df_leftout_nos, df_leftout_multi)
table(combined_survival_df$source)
```

### Combined: Truly / Wrong / NOS / Multi (4 groups) — one pooled Cox and KM

Truly L = outer CV + MLL non-NOS, non-Multi with truth L. Wrong L = RGAS misclassified as L only (exclude NOS and Multi). NOS predicted as L = left-out NOS (main) + MLL NOS with prediction L. Multi predicted as L = left-out Multi (main) with prediction L. All use main-cohort display names.

```{r survival_combined_four_groups}
true_by_label_comb <- split(combined_survival_df, combined_survival_df$truth_display)
# Wrong = misclassified, exclude NOS and Multi (only RGAS wrong predictions)
wrong_comb_rgas_only <- combined_survival_df[
  !combined_survival_df$correct &
  combined_survival_df$truth_display != "AML NOS" &
  combined_survival_df$truth_display != "Multi",
]
wrong_by_pred_comb <- split(wrong_comb_rgas_only, wrong_comb_rgas_only$prediction_display)
combined_nos_only <- combined_survival_df[combined_survival_df$truth_display == "AML NOS", ]
combined_multi_only <- combined_survival_df[combined_survival_df$truth_display == "Multi", ]

# Labels L that have at least Truly L and one of Wrong, NOS or Multi
labels_comb_four <- unique(c(
  names(true_by_label_comb),
  names(wrong_by_pred_comb),
  unique(combined_nos_only$prediction_display),
  unique(combined_multi_only$prediction_display)
))
labels_comb_four <- labels_comb_four[!labels_comb_four %in% c("AML NOS", "Multi")]
labels_comb_four <- labels_comb_four[vapply(labels_comb_four, function(L) !is.null(true_by_label_comb[[L]]) && nrow(true_by_label_comb[[L]]) > 0, logical(1))]

pooled_comb_four_list <- list()
for (L in labels_comb_four) {
  true_L <- true_by_label_comb[[L]]
  wrong_L <- wrong_by_pred_comb[[L]]
  nos_L <- combined_nos_only[combined_nos_only$prediction_display == L, ]
  multi_L <- combined_multi_only[combined_multi_only$prediction_display == L, ]
  if (is.null(true_L) || nrow(true_L) < 1) next

  parts <- list(
    data.frame(
      survival_days = true_L$survival_days,
      event = true_L$event,
      age_years = true_L$age_years,
      sex = true_L$sex,
      group = "Truly",
      label = L,
      cohort = true_L$cohort
    )
  )
  if (!is.null(wrong_L) && nrow(wrong_L) > 0)
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = wrong_L$survival_days,
      event = wrong_L$event,
      age_years = wrong_L$age_years,
      sex = wrong_L$sex,
      group = "Wrongly predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = wrong_L$cohort
    )
  if (nrow(nos_L) > 0)
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = nos_L$survival_days,
      event = nos_L$event,
      age_years = nos_L$age_years,
      sex = nos_L$sex,
      group = "NOS predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = nos_L$cohort
    )
  if (nrow(multi_L) > 0)
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      survival_days = multi_L$survival_days,
      event = multi_L$event,
      age_years = multi_L$age_years,
      sex = multi_L$sex,
      group = "Multi predicted as",
      label = L,
      cohort = multi_L$cohort
    )
  pooled_comb_four_list[[L]] <- do.call(rbind, parts)
}
pooled_comb_four_df <- do.call(rbind, pooled_comb_four_list)
pooled_comb_four_df$group <- factor(pooled_comb_four_df$group, levels = c("Truly", "Wrongly predicted as", "NOS predicted as", "Multi predicted as"))
pooled_comb_four_df$cohort <- factor(pooled_comb_four_df$cohort)
pooled_comb_four_df$sex <- factor(pooled_comb_four_df$sex)

# Summary n per group per label
survival_combined_summary_n <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pooled_comb_four_list), function(L) {
  d <- pooled_comb_four_list[[L]]
  data.frame(
    label = L,
    n_Truly = sum(d$group == "Truly"),
    n_Wrong = sum(d$group == "Wrongly predicted as"),
    n_NOS = sum(d$group == "NOS predicted as"),
    n_Multi = sum(d$group == "Multi predicted as")
  )
}))
survival_combined_summary_n
```

### Combined: Pooled Cox (4 groups, stratified by label)

```{r survival_combined_pooled}
cox_combined_four <- coxph(
  Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group + sex + cohort + strata(label),
  data = pooled_comb_four_df
)
summary(cox_combined_four)
```

### Combined: Kaplan-Meier Truly / Wrong / NOS / Multi by label

```{r survival_combined_km, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
km_comb_four_list <- list()
for (L in names(pooled_comb_four_list)) {
  dat_L <- pooled_comb_four_df[pooled_comb_four_df$label == L, ]
  if (length(unique(dat_L$group)) < 2) next
  fit_L <- survfit(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group, data = dat_L)
  s_df <- summary(fit_L, data.frame = TRUE)
  s_df$group <- as.character(s_df$strata)
  if (any(grepl("=", s_df$group))) s_df$group <- sub("^[^=]+=", "", s_df$group)
  s_df$label <- L
  if (!"lower" %in% names(s_df)) s_df$lower <- NA_real_
  if (!"upper" %in% names(s_df)) s_df$upper <- NA_real_
  km_comb_four_list[[L]] <- s_df[, c("time", "surv", "lower", "upper", "group", "label")]
}
km_comb_four_df <- do.call(rbind, km_comb_four_list)
if (nrow(km_comb_four_df) > 0) {
  km_comb_four_df$group <- factor(km_comb_four_df$group, levels = c("Truly", "Wrongly predicted as", "NOS predicted as", "Multi predicted as"))
  p_km_combined <- ggplot(km_comb_four_df, aes(x = time / 365.25, y = surv, colour = group)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = group), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (years)") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Survival probability", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(colour = "Group", fill = "Group", title = "Combined: Truly L vs Wrong vs NOS vs Multi predicted as L") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  p_km_combined
}
```

### Combined: Global KM (Correct / Wrong / NOS / Multi)

```{r survival_combined_global_km, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Global grouping in combined survival data (outer CV + MLL + left-out NOS/Multi)
combined_survival_df$group_global <- dplyr::case_when(
  combined_survival_df$truth_display == "AML NOS" ~ "Truth AML NOS",
  combined_survival_df$truth_display == "Multi" ~ "Truth Multi",
  grepl("NOS", combined_survival_df$prediction_display) ~ "Prediction NOS",
  grepl("Multi", combined_survival_df$prediction_display) ~ "Prediction Multi",
  combined_survival_df$correct ~ "Predicted correctly",
  TRUE ~ "Predicted incorrectly"
)
combined_survival_df$group_global <- factor(
  combined_survival_df$group_global,
  levels = c("Predicted correctly", "Predicted incorrectly", "Prediction NOS", "Prediction Multi", "Truth AML NOS", "Truth Multi")
)

if (length(unique(na.omit(combined_survival_df$group_global))) >= 2) {
  fit_comb_global <- survfit(Surv(survival_days, event) ~ group_global, data = combined_survival_df)
  s_df_comb <- summary(fit_comb_global, data.frame = TRUE)
  s_df_comb$group_global <- as.character(s_df_comb$strata)
  if (any(grepl("=", s_df_comb$group_global))) s_df_comb$group_global <- sub("^[^=]+=", "", s_df_comb$group_global)
  if (!"lower" %in% names(s_df_comb)) s_df_comb$lower <- NA_real_
  if (!"upper" %in% names(s_df_comb)) s_df_comb$upper <- NA_real_

  p_km_comb_global <- ggplot(s_df_comb, aes(x = time / 365.25, y = surv, colour = group_global)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = group_global), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Time (years)") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Survival probability", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      colour = "Group",
      fill = "Group",
      title = "Combined: global KM by prediction correctness / NOS / Multi"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  p_km_comb_global
}
```
